english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Combing the hair removes ailments, and combing the beard strengthens the teeth."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 128 • Al-Ādāb al-Dīniyyah, Part 1, p. 66 • Makarim Al- Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 70 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 667 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 124 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 117

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
english_text:
Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} said: "When you comb your
beard and head, pass the comb over your chest as well, for it removes worry and
lethargy”.
references: Al-Kafi, Volume 6, p. 489 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 128 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 70 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 668 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 125 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 117

Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "Whoever combs their beard
seventy times and counts it one by one will not be approached by Shaytan (Satan) for
forty days."
commentary:
Additionally, there is no harm in using combs made of ivory, kohl applicators, and
ointment containers.
references: Al-Kafi, Volume 6, p. 489 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 128 • Al-Ādāb al-Dīniyyah, Part 1, p. 66 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 70 • Security, Part 1, p. 37 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 669 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 126 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 117

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON

english_text:
Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} said:
"Comb your hair with combs made of ivory, for it removes ailments."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 129 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 70 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 123 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 117

.وهو إلحمى

Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "Combing the hair removes
ailments," referring specifically to fever. In a narration by Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah al-
Barqi, it is stated: 'It removes fatigue,' meaning weakness.
Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, said:
'And do not slacken in My remembrance,' (Surah Taha 20:42) meaning do not become
weak.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 129 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Part 1, p. 409

arabic_text:

english_text:
Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} said:
"There are three things which, if a person understands them, they will not abandon:
trimming the hair, shortening the garment, and marrying bondwomen."
references: Al-Kafi, Volume 6, p. 484 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 129 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 647 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 104 • Wasa’il Al-Shia, vol. 5, p. 38 • Wasa’il Al-Shia, vol. 20, p. 256

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said to some of his companions:
"Cut your hair short to reduce its dirt, pests, and grime; it will strengthen your neck,
improve your eyesight, and provide relief for your body."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said: "Whoever grows their hair should take good
care of it or cut it short."
references: Al-Kafi, Volume 6, p. 485 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 129 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 70 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 651 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 129 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 83

english_text: He {a.s} said: "Beautiful hair is part of Allah’s {SWT} provision, so honor it."

Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Whoever grows their hair and does not part it, Allah {SWT} will part it with a saw of fire."
commentary:
The hair of the Messenger of Allah {saws} was shoulder-length but did not reach (enough)
to part.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 129 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 2, p. 20

english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said: "Trim your mustaches and let your beards
grow, and do not resemble the Jews."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 130 • Wasa’il Al-Shia, vol. 2, p. 116

"The Messenger of Allah {saws} once saw (looked) a man with a long beard, and
said: "It would have been better if he had trimmed his beard.
When the man heard this, he trimmed his beard to a moderate length. Then entered to
see the Prophet. When the Prophet saw him, He {saws} said: "This is how you should do
it. "
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said: "The Magians (Zoroastrians) trim their beards
and let their mustaches grow long, but we trim the mustaches and let the beards grow,
and this is the natural disposition (fitrah)."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 130 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 657 • Wasa’il Al-Shia, vol. 2, p.

Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "Whatever extends beyond a fist-
length of the beard is in the Fire."

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Muslim said: "I saw Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} while
the barber was trimming his beard, and Imam {a.s} said: 'Shape it evenly.'
references: Al-Kafi, Volume 6, p. 487 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 130 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, vol. 1, p. 68 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 656 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’a, vol. 2, p. 110 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 46, p. 299 • Awalim al-Ulum, Vol. 19, p. 235

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "Hold your beard with your hand
(in a fist) and trim what is excess."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 130 • The Makarem al-Akhlaq, Part 1, p. 68 • Bihar Al- Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 113

english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said:
"Gray hair at the front of the head is a sign of blessing, at the temples is a sign of
generosity, at the hair ends is a sign of courage, and at the nape of the neck is a sign of
ill-omen."

ً «إ َّو َّلُّ مَّ ن ْ س َّ اب َّ إ ِن ْزَّإهِي مُّ إَّلْح َّ لِي لُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ وَّ إ ِن َّهُّ ي َّن َّى لِحْ ي َّي َّهُّ ق َّزَّإ َّى طَّ اق َّه
ًن َّي ْص َّ اءَّ ق َّق َّالَّ ي َّا ج َّ ن ْزَّن ِي لُّ مَّ ا هَّذ َّإ ق َّق َّالَّ هَّذ َّإ وَّ ق َّار ق َّق َّالَّ إ ِن ْزَّإهِي مُّ إَّلل َّهُّم َّ ر ِذْ ن ِى وَّ ق َّارإ.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "The first person to have gray hair
was Ibrahim {a.s}, the Friend (Khaleel) of Allah {SWT}. When he saw a white strand in his
beard, He {a.s} said: 'O’ Archangel Jibril {a.s}, what is this?'
Archangel Jibril {a.s} said: "'This is dignity (Waqar).'
So Ibrahim {a.s} replied: 'O’ Allah {SWT}, increase me in dignity.'
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 130 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 644

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON

english_text:
Imam {a.s} said: "Whoever grows a gray hair in Islam, it will be a light for them on
the Day of Judgment."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 130 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 644

english_text: The Messenger of Allah {saws} said: "Gray hair is light, so do not pluck it."
references: Da‘ā’im al-Islām, Part 1, p. 125 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 130 • Al-Ash'athiyat, Part 1, p. 156 • The Makarem al-Akhlaq, Part 1, p. 68 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 644 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 130 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 107

"It is reported that Imam Ali {a.s} saw no harm in cutting gray hair but disliked
plucking it."

The prohibition against plucking grey hair is a dislike rather than a strict prohibition,

ِإَّلص َّ اذِق َّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ ي َّق ُّولُّ: «لأَّ ن َّا ْسَّ ن ِح َّ ز ِّ إَّلس َّ مَّظِ وَّ ن َّي ْق ِهِ وَّ ج َّ ز ُّةُّ إ َّجَّ ث ُّ إ ِلَّى َّ مِن ْ ن َّي ْق ِه .
ق ا ج ن ارهم علي هم إلسلام لأ ي ح ي لف ق ى جاله وإجذة لأن مح زج ها من عن ذ إلله ي عالى ذ كزة، وإ ن ما ي ح ي لف ن حسث إج ي لاف
.إلأ جوإل
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} says: "There is no harm in cutting gray
hair or plucking it, but cutting it is more beloved to me than plucking it."
commentary:
Their (Imams ) hadiths do not differ in one case to another because it comes from Allah
{SWT}, the Exalted; rather, it differs according to the variation of circumstances
references: Al-Kafi, Volume 6, p. 492 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 131 • The Makarem al- Akhlaq, Part 1, p. 69 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 644 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 130 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 107

arabic_text:

ُّ «إ َّرْن َّغ مِن ْ إ َّج ْ لاَّق ِ إَّلْأ َّن ْن ِي َّاءِ عَّلَّي ْهِمُّ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ إَّلي َّطَّ ي ُّث ُّ وَّ إَّلي َّن ْط ِ ي ف ُّ ن ِالْمُّوسَّ ى وَّ جَّ لْق
ِ إَّلْح َّ سَّ ذِ ن ِالن ُّورَّة ِ وَّ كَّي ْ زَّة ُّ إَّلط َّ زُّوق َّه. »
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"There are four traits of the Prophets: using fragrance, grooming with a razor, shaving
the body with Nuura (depilatory paste), and frequenting the mosque."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 131 • Makarem al-Akhlaq, Part 1, p. 40 • Makarem al- Akhlaq, Part 1, p. 63 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 615 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 107 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 73, p. 93

Chapter Title: THE RITUAL BATH OF JUMU’AH, ENTERING THE BATHHOUSE, ITS ETIQUETTE, AND TEACHINGS ON
arabic_text:

ِ جَّ اج َّ ي َّكُّمْ ي َّوْ مَّ إَّلْح َّ مِي سِ وَّ ي َّطَّ ي َّن ُّوإ ن ِا َّطْ ي َّث ِ طِ ي ن ِكُّمْ ي َّوْ مَّ إَّلْح ُّ مُّعَّه .
english_text:
Imam {a.s} said: "Trim your nails on Tuesday, bathe on Wednesday, fulfil your
need for cupping (hijama) on Thursday, and use your best fragrance on Jumu’ah."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Khasal, Part 2, p. 391 • Uyūn al-Akhbār, Part 1, p. 279 • Al-Ādāb al-Dīniyyah, Part 1, p. 149 • The Makarem al-Akhlaq, Part 1, p. 55 • The Makarem al-Akhlaq, Part 1, p. 55 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 4, p. 13 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 687 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 7, p. 366 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 56, p. 23

. وهذ ة إلكماب هى كلماب إلق زح
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "The Messenger of Allah {saws}
entered upon a man from the Banu Hashim who was in the throes of death and said to
him: 'Say :
'There is no Allah {SWT} but Allah {SWT}, the Forbearing, the Generous; there is no God but
Allah {SWT}, the Most High, the Most Great; Glory be to Allah {SWT}, the Lord {AZJ} of the seven
heavens and the Lord {AZJ} of the seven earths and what is in them and what is between
them and what is beneath them, and the Lord {AZJ} of the Mighty Throne. Peace be upon
the messengers, and all praise is due to Allah {SWT}, the Lord {AZJ} of all the worlds.'
The man said thusly, and the Messenger of Allah {saws} said: 'Praise be to Allah {SWT} who
has saved him from the Fire.'".
commentary: These words are known as the Words of Relief.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

arabic_text:

«إ ِن َّكُّمْ ي ُّلَّق ِّن ُّون َّ مَّ وْ ي َّاكُّمْ : لأَّ إ ِلَّهَّ إ ِلأ َّ إَّلل َّهُّ عِ ن ْذَّ إَّلْمَّوْ ب ِ وَّ ن َّحْ ن ُّ ن ُّلَّق ِّن ُّ مَّ وْ ي َّان َّا مُّحَّ م َّذ
ِرَّسُّ ولُّ إَّلل َّه .
english_text:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said: "You instruct your deceased to say
'There is no god but Allah {SWT}' at the time of death, while we instruct our deceased to
say 'Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah {saws}.'".
references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 122 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 131 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 231 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 454

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال َّرَّسُّ ولُّ إَّلل َّهِ ض:
َّ «لَّق ِّن ُّوإ مَّ وْ ي َّاكُّمْ لأَّ إ ِلَّهَّ إ ِلأ َّ إَّلل َّهُّ ق َّا ِن َّ مَّ ن ْ كَّان َّ إ ج ِ زُّ كَّلاَّمِهِ لأَّ إ ِلَّهَّ إ ِلأ َّ إَّلل َّهُّ ذَّج َّ لَّ إَّلْح َّ ن َّه.
english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said: "Instruct your dying to say 'There is no god
but Allah {SWT},' for whoever's last words are 'There is no god but Allah {SWT}' will enter
Paradise."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 132 • Thawab al-A’mal wa Iqab al-A’mal, Part 1, p. 195 • Al-Amali (by Al-Saduq) Vol. 1, p. 540 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 237 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 455 • Wasail Al- Shia, Part 2, p. 456 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 78, p. 232 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 90, p. 199

english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "The believer is most rational
(aware) at the time of their death."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 132 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 238 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 456

english_text:
Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "During the time of the Messenger of Allah {saws}, a man
from the people of Medina was unable to speak due to throes of death.
The Messenger of Allah {saws} entered upon him and said:
'Say: There is no god but Allah {SWT}.'
But the man was unable to say it.
The Messenger of Allah {saws} repeated it to him, but he still could not say it.
At the head of this man was a woman, and He asked her: 'Is this man’s mother
present?'"
She said: 'Yes, O’ Messenger of Allah {saws}, I am his mother.'
He asked her: 'Are you pleased with him or displeased?'
She said: 'I am displeased with him.'
Messenger of Allah {saws} said to her: "I would like that you become pleased with him,"
She said: 'I am pleased with him for your sake, O’ Messenger of Allah {saws}.'
He {saws} then said to him: "Say: There is no god but Allah {SWT}.'"
(the man) replied: "There is no god but Allah {SWT}."
Then He {saws} said: 'Say: O’ One who accepts the small and forgives the great, accept
from me the small and forgive the great, for You are Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful.'
(the man) said it, and then Prophet {saws} asked him, 'What do you see?'
(the man) replied: 'I see two dark figures approaching me.'
He {saws} said: 'Repeat the supplication.'
So he repeated it, and Prophet {saws} said: 'What do you see now?'
(the man) replied: 'They have moved away from me, and two white figures have come
in, and the dark figures have left. I no longer see them, and the white figures are now
drawing close to me to take my soul.' The man then passed away thereafter.

Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about the positioning of the deceased.
Imam {a.s} said: "Direct the soles of their feet toward the Qibla”.

english_text:
The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said:
"The Messenger of Allah {saws} entered upon a man from the descendants of Abdul
Muttalib, while he was in the throes of death and was facing away from the Qibla.
The Prophet said: 'Direct him toward the Qibla, for when you do so, the angels will
approach him, and Allah {SWT}, the Mighty, will turn toward him with His face (attention).'
And he remained in that state until he passed away.”
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 133 • Thawab al-A’mal wa Iqab al-A’mal, Part 1, p. 195 • Ilal al-Sharai’ Vol. 1, p. 297 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 3, p. 36 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 228 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 453 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 78, p. 230

english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"There is no one who is faced with death except that Iblis (Satan) sends some of his
devils to entice him toward disbelief and to cause him to doubt his faith until his soul
departs.
Therefore, when you are present with your dying ones, instruct them to bear witness
that there is no god but Allah {SWT} and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah {saws}
until they pass away."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 233 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 455 • Al-Fusul al-Muhimmah, Part 2, p. 32 • Al-Fusul al-Muhimmah, Part 3, p. 297 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 6, p. 195 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 60, p. 257

english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said in his last sermon:
"Whoever repents a year before his death, Allah {SWT} will accept his repentance."
Then He {saws} said: "A year is a long time; whoever repents a month before their death,
Allah {SWT} will accept their repentance."
Then He {saws} said: "A month is a long time; whoever repents a week before their death,
Allah {SWT} will accept their repentance."
Then He {saws} said: "A week is a long time; whoever repents a day before their death,
Allah {SWT} will accept their repentance."
Then He {saws} said: "A day is a long time; whoever repents an hour before their death,
Allah {SWT} will accept their repentance."
Then He {saws} said: “An hour is a long time; whoever repents before their soul reaches
here" - and he pointed to his throat - "Allah {SWT} will accept their repentance”.

english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about the words of Allah
{SWT}, the Mighty and Glorious:
"But repentance is not [accepted] of those who [continue to] do evil deeds up until,
when death comes to one of them, he says, 'Indeed, I repent now’."
(Surah An Nisa 4:18).
Imam {a.s} said: "That is when they witness the realities of the Hereafter."

english_text:
A man from the Bedouins, who had servants and camels, came to the
Messenger of Allah {saws} and said:
"O’ Messenger of Allah {saws}, inform me about the words of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and
Glorious: 'Those who believe and are conscious of Allah {SWT} - they will have good
news in this world and in the Hereafter'
(Surah Yunus 10:63-64)
The Prophet replied: "As for His {SWT} words, 'They will have good news in this world,' it
refers to the good dreams that a believer sees and is given glad tidings by them in this
world.
And as for 'and in the Hereafter,' it refers to the glad tidings a believer receives at the
time of death, that Allah {SWT} has forgiven you and those who carry you to your grave."

َّ«ق ِي لَّ لِمَّلَّك ِ إَّلْمَّوْ ب ِ علي ه إلسلام ، كَّي ْف َّ ي َّق ْن ِض ُّ إَّلْأ َّرْوَّ إحَّ وَّ ن َّعْ ص ُّ هَّا ق ِى إَّلْمَّع ْ زِب ِ و
َّن َّعْ ص ُّ هَّا ق ِى إَّلْمَّس ْ زِق ِ ق ِى سَّ اعَّه ٍ وَّ إجِ ذَّة ٍ ق َّق َّالَّ إ َّذْ عُّوهَّا ق َّي ُّح ِ ي ن ُّن ِى » ق َّالَّ «ق َّق َّالَّ مَّ لَّك ُّ إَّلْمَّوْ ب ِ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إ َّ لس َّ لاَّمُّ إ ِن َّ إَّلذ ُّن ْي َّ ا ن َّي ْن
َّ ي َّذَّى َّ كَّالْق َّصْ عَّه ِ ن َّي ْن َّ ي َّذَّى ْ إ َّجَّ ذِكُّمْ ي َّي َّن َّاوَّ لُّ مِن ْهَّا مَّ ا س َّ اءَّ وَّ إَّلذ ُّن ْي َّا عِ ن ْذِى كَّالذِّ رْهَّمِ ق ِى كَّف ِّ إ ُّجَّ ذِكُّمْ ي ُّق َّلِّن ُّهُّ كَّي ْف َّ ي َّس َّ اء .
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"It was said to the Angel of Death {a.s}, 'How do you seize souls while some are in the
west and others in the east at the same moment?'
He said: 'I summon them, and they respond to me.'
Imam {a.s} said: “Then, The Angel of Death, said:
'The world is like a bowl in front of me from which I take as I please, and the world is
like a coin in the palm of one of you, which you turn as you wish.'
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 266 • Al-Fusul al-Muhimmah, Part 1, p. 301 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, vol. 4, p. 390 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 6, p. 144

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال ُّإَّلص َّ اذِق ُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
َّ «مَّ ا ي َّح ْ زُّح ُّ مُّو ْ مِن عَّن ِ إَّلذ ُّن ْي َّا إ ِلأ َّ ن ِزِص اً مِن ْهُّ وَّ ذ َّلِك َّ إ َّن َّ إَّلل َّهَّ ي َّن َّارَّك وي َّعَّالَّى ُّ ي َّكْس ِ ف
ُّ لَّهُّ إَّلْع ِطَّ اءَّ جَّ ي َّى ي َّن ْط ُّ زَّ إ ِلَّى مَّ كَّان ِهِ مِن َّ إَّلْح َّ ن َّه ِ وَّ مَّ ا إ َّعَّذ َّ إَّلل َّهُّ لَّهُّ ق ِي هَّا وَّ ي ُّن ْصَّ ث ُّ لَّهُّ إَّلذ ُّن ْي َّا كَّا َّجْ سَّ ن ِ مَّ ا كَّان َّث ْ لَّهُّ ي ُّم َّ ي ُّح َّ ي َّز
ِ ق َّي َّح ْ ي َّارُّ مَّ ا عِ ن ْذَّ إَّلل َّهِ عَّز َّ وَّ ج َّ ل َّ وَّ ي َّق ُّولُّ مَّ ا إ َّصْ ن َّغُّ ن ِ الذ ُّن ْي َّا وَّ ن َّلاَّن ِهَّا ق َّلَّق ِّن ُّوإ مَّ وْ ي َّاكُّمْ كَّلِمَّاب ِ إَّلْق َّزَّح .
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"No believer leaves this world except with contentment, for Allah {SWT}, Blessed and
Exalted, lifts the veil for them until they see their place in Paradise and what Allah {SWT}
has prepared for them there.
Then the world is shown to them as the best it could have been, and they are given the
choice, so they choose what is with Allah {SWT}, Mighty and Glorious, and they say,
'What do I need with the world and its trials?'
Therefore, instruct your dying with the Words of Relief (Kalimat E Faraj)."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 245 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 460 • Al-Fusul al-Muhimmah, Part 3, p. 298

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال ُّإ َّن ُّو ج َّ عْ ق َّزٍ إَّلْن َّاق ِزُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
«لَّوْ إ َّذْ رَّكْث ُّ عِ كْزِمَّ ه َّ عِ ن ْذَّ إَّلْمَّوْ ب ِ لَّن َّق َّعْ ي ُّهُّ» ق َّق ِي لَّ لِلص َّ اذِق ِ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ ن ِمَّا
ِذ َّإ كَّان َّ ي َّن ْق َّعُّهُّ ق َّالَّ «كَّان َّ ي ُّلَّق ِّن ُّهُّ مَّ ا إ َّن ْي ُّمْ عَّلَّي ْ ه .
english_text:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"If I had reached Ikrimah at the time of his death, I would have benefited him."
When Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked (about this narration), Imam
{a.s} explained:
"He (Imam Al Baqir {a.s} would have instructed him (ikrimah) in what you are upon
(referring to the beliefs of faithful)”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال ِرَّسُّ ولُّ إَّلل َّهِ صَّ ل َّى إَّلل َّهُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ وَّ إ لِه:
«إ ِن َّ مَّ وْ ب َّ إَّلْق َّح ْ ا َّة ِ ي َّح ْ ق ِي ف عَّلَّى إَّلْمُّو ْ مِن ِ وَّ رَّإجَّ ه وَّ إ َّج ْ ذ َّة ُّ إ َّسَّ ف ٍ عَّلَّى
ِإَّلْكَّاق ِز.
english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said: "Sudden death is an ease and relief for the
believer but a regretful taking for the disbeliever”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 112 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 134 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 205

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Death is the expiation for the sins of every believer."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 134 • Al-Amali Volume 1, p. 283 • Amali (by Al-Tusi) Vol. 1, p. 110 • Taʾwīl al-Āyāt, Part 1, p. 148 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 274 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 6, p. 151 • Bihar Al- Anwar, Vol. 79, p. 178 • Tafseer Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Part 3, p. 541

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
english_text:
The Imam {a.s} said:
"Indeed, between this world and the Hereafter, there are a thousand obstacles, the
easiest and least difficult of which is death."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 134 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 275

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال ُّإَّلص َّ اذِق ُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
ِ«إ ِن َّ إَّلس َّ ي ْطَّ ان َّ لَّي َّا ْي ِى إَّلز َّج ُّ لَّ مِن ْ إ َّوْ لِي َّان ِن َّا عِ ن ْذَّ مَّ وْ ي ِهِ عَّن ْ ي َّمِي ن ِهِ وَّ عَّن ْ س ِ مَّالِه
:لِي ُّص ِ ل َّهُّ عَّم َّا هُّوَّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ ق َّي َّا ْن َّى إَّلل َّهُّ عَّز َّ وَّ ج َّ ل َّ ذ َّلِك َّ وَّ ذ َّلِك َّ ق َّوْ لُّ إَّلل َّهِ ي َّعَّالَّى
«۝
ِ ي ُّي َّن ِّث ُّ إَّللّٰهُّ إَّل َّذ ِي ن َّ إ مَّ ن ُّوإ ن ِالْق َّوْ لِ إَّلي ّٰان ِث ِ ق ِى إَّلْحَّ ي ٰ اة ِ إَّلذ ُّن ْي ٰ ا وَّ ق ِى إَّلْأ ج ِ زَّة ۝ »
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "Indeed, Shaytan comes to one
of our followers at the time of their death, approaching from their right and from their
left to lead them astray from what they are upon. But Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and
Glorious, refuses this, and this is the meaning of Allah’s {SWT} words:
'Allah {SWT} will keep firm those who believe, with the firm word, in this worldly life and
in the Hereafter'" (Surah Ibrahim 14:27).
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 134 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 258 • Tafsir al-Safi, Part 3, p. 86 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Part 2, p. 541 • Tafseer Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Part 7, p. 60

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال ُّإَّلص َّ اذِق ُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
«ق ِى إَّلْمَّي ِّث ِ ي َّذْ مَّ غُّ عَّي ْن َّاةُّ عِ ن ْذَّ إَّلْمَّوْ ب ِ وَّ إ ِن َّ ذ َّلِك َّ عِ ن ْذَّ مُّعَّاي َّن َّه ِ رَّسُّ ولِ إَّلل َّهِ صَّ ل َّى
َّ إَّلل َّهُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ وَّ إ لِهِ ق َّي َّزَّى مَّ ا ي َّسُّ ز ُّةُّ» ي ُّم َّ ق َّالَّ «إ َّ مَّ ا ي َّزَّى إَّلز َّج ُّ لَّ ي َّزَّى مَّ ا ي َّسُّ ز ُّةُّ وَّ مَّ ا ي ُّحِ ث ُّ ق َّي ُّذْ مَّ غُّ عَّي ْن َّاة
ُّ وَّ ي َّص ْ حَّ ك .
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "When a believer is at the
moment of death, tears may come to their eyes because, at that moment, they witness
the presence of the Messenger of Allah {saws} and they see what pleases them."
Then Imam {a.s} said: "Do you not see that when a person sees what delights and
pleases them, tears come to their eyes and they smile?"
references: Asceticism, Part 1, p. 83 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 133 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 135 • Ilal al-Sharai’ Vol. 1, p. 306 • Ma’ani al-Akhbar, Part 1, p. 236 • Al-Muḥtaḍar, Part 1, p. 39 • Al-Fusul al- Muhimmah, Part 1, p. 303 • Madīnat Maʿājiz al-Aʾimma ʿAlayhim al-Salām, Part 3, p. 114 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 6, p. 182 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Vol. 2, p. 161

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "If you see a believer whose eyes
are fixed, the left eye tears up, the forehead perspires, the lips contract, and the
nostrils widen, then that is sufficient for you (as a sign of their passing)."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 135 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Vol. 2, p. 161

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال ُّإ َّن ُّو ج َّ عْ ق َّزٍ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
َّ«إ ِن َّ إ ي َّه َّ إَّلْمُّو ْ مِن ِ إ ِذ َّإ جَّ ص َّ زَّةُّ إَّلْمَّوْ ب ُّ إ َّن ْ ي َّن ْي َّض َّ وَّ ج ْ هُّهُّ إ َّس َّ ذ َّ مِن ْ ن َّي َّاض ِ لَّوْ ن ِهِ و
ِ ي َّزْس َّ حَّ ج َّ ن ِي ن ُّهُّ وَّ ي َّسِ ي لَّ مِن ْ عَّي ْن َّي ْ هِ كَّهَّي ْ ن َّه ِ إَّلذ ُّمُّوعِ ق َّي َّكُّون ُّ ذ َّلِك َّ إ ي َّه َّ ج ُّ زُّوح ِ رُّوجِ هِ وَّ إ ِن َّ إَّلْكَّاق ُّزَّ ي َّح ْ زُّح ُّ رُّوجُّ ه ْ سَّ لاًّ مِن
ِس ِ ذْ ق ِهِ كَّز َّن َّذِ إَّلْن َّعِي زِ كَّمَّا ي َّح ْ زُّح ُّ ن َّق ْ سُّ إَّلْحِ مَّار .
english_text:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"The sign of a believer when death approaches is that their face becomes whiter than
its usual color, their forehead perspires, and tears flow from their eyes like drops. This
is the sign of the departure of their soul. As for the disbeliever, their soul exits from
their mouth forcefully, like the froth of a camel or the expiration of a donkey."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 135 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Part 4, p. 225 • Tafseer Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Part 10, p. 290 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Vol. 2, p. 161

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
english_text:
It is reported:
"The last taste that a person experiences at the time of death is the taste of grapes."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 135 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 275

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
arabic_text:
ِوَّ سُّ ن ِلَّ رَّسُّ ولُّ إَّلل َّه ُّ صَّ ل َّى إَّلل َّهُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ وَّ إ لِهِ كَّي ْف َّ ي َّي َّوَّ ق َّى مَّ لَّك ُّ إَّلْمَّوْ ب ِ إَّلْمُّو ْ مِن َّ ق َّق َّالَّ «إ ِن َّ مَّ لَّك َّ إَّلْمَّوْ ب ِ لَّي َّق ِف َّ مِن
َّإَّلْمُّو ْ مِن ِ عِ ن ْذَّ مَّ وْ ي ِهِ مَّ وْ ق ِف َّ إَّلْعَّن ْذِ إَّلذ َّلِي لِ مِن َّ إَّلْمَّوْ لَّى ق َّي َّق ُّومُّ وَّ إ َّصْ حَّ ان ُّهُّ لأَّ ي َّذْ ن ُّون َّ مِن ْهُّ ج ُّي َّى ي َّن ْذَّإ َّةُّ ن ِالي َّسْ لِي مِ وَّ ي ُّن َّس ِّ زَّة
ِ ن ِالْح َّ ن َّه.
english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} was asked how the Angel of Death takes the soul
of a believer.
He {saws} replied: "Indeed, the Angel of Death stands before the believer at the time of
their death in the position of a humble servant before their master. He and his
companions do not approach until the believer is greeted with peace and given glad
tidings of Paradise."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 135 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 266 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 6, p. 167 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Part 4, p. 225 • Tafseer Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Part 10, p. 290

arabic_text:

َّ «إ ِن َّ إَّلْمُّو ْ مِن َّ إ ِذ َّإ جَّ ص َّ زَّةُّ إَّلْمَّوْ ب ُّ وَّ ي َّق َّهُّ مَّ لَّك ُّ إَّلْمَّوْ ب ِ ق َّلَّوْ لأَّ ذ َّلِك َّ لَّمْ ي َّسْ ي َّق ِز .
وما من إ جذ ي حص زة إلموب إ لأ مي ل له إلن ن ى صلى إلله علي ه وإ له وإلحح ح صلوإب إلله علي هم إ ج معي ن جي ى ي زإهم، ق ا ن كان
:مو من ا ي زإهم ن حي ث ي حث ، وإ ن كان ع ي ز مو من ي زإهم ن حي ث ي كزة، وق ال إلله ي ن ارك وي عالى "۝
ق لولأ إ ذ إ ن لع ث إلحلق وم
وإ ن ي م جي ن ن ذ ي ن ط زون ون حن إ ق زب إ لي ه من كم ولكن لأ ي ن صزون
۝.
commentary:
when death approaches, The Prophet {saws} and the divinely appointed proofs (Imams,
peace be upon them all) are made present to the dying person so that they may see
them. If the person is a believer, they will see them in a pleasing state; if they are not a
believer, they will see them in a way they dislike. Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, has said:
"Then why, when the soul reaches the throat, and you are at that moment looking on,
and We are nearer to him than you, but you do not see" (Sural Al Waqi’ah 56:83-85)
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 135 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Part 4, p. 225 • Tafseer Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Part 10, p. 290

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED

Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "When the soul reaches the throat, the person
(believer), is shown their place in Paradise. They say, 'Return me to the world so that I
may inform my family about what I see.' But it is said to them, 'There is no way for that.'"
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

ِ مَّ لَّك ِ إَّلْمَّوْ ب .
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about the different Qur'anic
verses that mention Allah {SWT} taking souls at the time of death, about the words of
Allah {SWT}, the Exalted: "Allah {SWT} takes the souls at the time of their death,"
(Surah Az-Zumar 39:42)
And about the words of Allah {SWT}, the Exalted:
"Say, 'The Angel of Death, who is put in charge of you, will take you,'" (Surah As-Sajdah
32:11)
And about the words of Allah {SWT}, the Exalted:
"Those whom the angels take while they are in a state of purity," (Surah An-Nahl 16:32)
And "Those whom the angels take while they are wronging themselves," (Surah An-
Nahl 16:28)
And about the words of Allah {SWT}, the Exalted: "Our messengers angels take them,"
(Surah Al-An’am 6:61)
And about His words:
"And if you could see when the angels take the souls of those who disbelieved." (Surah
Al-Anfal 8:50)
The questioner further inquired about how this process works, given that countless
souls may die simultaneously across the world
Imam Al-Sadiq replied: "Indeed, Allah {SWT}, Blessed and Exalted, has appointed for the
Angel of Death assistants among the angels who seize souls. They function similarly
to a chief of police who has deputies among the people whom he sends out to fulfil
tasks on his behalf. Thus, the angels take the souls, and the Angel of Death receives
them from the angels along with what he himself seizes. Ultimately Allah {SWT}, Blessed
and Exalted, takes them from Angel of Death”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 266 • Al-Fusul al-Muhimmah, Part 1, p. 302 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol. 2, p. 427 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 6, p. 144 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Part 3, p. 51 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Part 4, p. 223 • Tafseer Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Part 7, p. 204 • Tafseer Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Part 10, p. 287

Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Indeed, the follower of Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} will see him in three places that bring
joy: at the time of death, at the Sirat (the bridge over Hell), and at the Hawdh (the
Pool)."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

english_text:
The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali {a.s} said: "When a servant is in their
last day of this world and their first day of Hereafter; their wealth, children, and deeds
are presented before them.
They turn to their wealth and say, 'By Allah {SWT}, I was extremely attached and miserly
with you; what do you have for me now?'
It (wealth) replies, 'Take your shroud from me.'
Then they turn to their children and say, 'By Allah {SWT}, I loved you and I was protective
over you; what do you have for me now?'
They (children) respond, 'We will carry you to your grave and bury you in it.'
Then they turn to their deeds and say, 'By Allah {SWT}, you were burdensome upon me,
and I was reluctant toward you; what do you have for me now?'
It (deeds) replies, 'I am your companion in your grave and on the Day of Resurrection
until you and I are presented before your Lord {AZJ}.'".
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said:
"Whoever dies on a Jumu’ah or on the night of Jumu’ah, Allah {SWT} will relieve him from
the punishment of the grave."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 138 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 269

english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "Whoever dies between the
decline of the sun on Thursday until the decline of the sun on will be safe from the
squeezing (pressure) of the grave."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 138 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 269

english_text:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said: "Jumu’ah night is a radiant night,
and its day is a radiant day. There is no day on the face of the earth on which the sun
sets with more people freed from the Fire than on Jumu’ah.
Whoever dies on Jumu’ah, Allah {SWT} will write for them freedom from the punishment
of the grave, and whoever dies on Jumu’ah will be freed from the Fire."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 138 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 269

english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "There is no dying person for
whom Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Glorious, does not return their sight, hearing, and
intellect at the moment of death, whether they are giving a final will or not. This is the
'relief of death' that is referred to as the comfort of passing away."
commentary:
And if a person in the throes of death moves their hands, feet, or head, they should not
be restrained, as is done by ignorant people. If their soul's departure becomes severe,
they should be moved to the place where they used to pray or on it. They should not be
touched during this time. When they have passed, it is appropriate to say : "Indeed, we
belong to Allah {SWT}, and to Him we return."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

ِعَّي ْن َّي ْ هِ إ َّوْ مِن ْ ق ِي هِ وَّ مَّ ا ي َّح ْ زُّح ُّ إ َّجَّ ذ مِن َّ إَّلذ ُّن ْي َّا جَّ ي َّى ي َّزَّى مَّ كَّان َّهُّ مِن َّ إَّلْح َّ ن َّه ِ إ َّوْ مِن َّ إَّلن َّار .
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked: "For what reason is the
deceased washed (given ghusl)?"
Imam {a.s} said: "The drop that he was created from, exits from their eyes or their mouth,
and no one leaves this world until they see their place in either Paradise or the Fire."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال ُّإَّلص َّ اذِق ُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
ً«مَّ ن ْ مَّ اب َّ مُّ حْ زِماً ن َّعَّي َّهُّ إَّلل َّهُّ مُّ لَّن ِّي ا .
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Whoever dies in the state of Ihram (consecration for Hajj or Umrah), Allah {SWT} will
resurrect them reciting the Talbiyah."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 138 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 271 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 505 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 7, p. 302

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
english_text:
The Imam {a.s} said:
"Whoever dies in one of the two sanctuaries (Makkah or Madinah) will be safe from the
Great Terror on the Day of Resurrection."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 139 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 271

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
arabic_text: َّوَّ ق َّال ِ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ: «إَّلْمَّزْإ َّة ُّ إ ِذ َّإ مَّ اي َّث ْ ق ِى ن ِق َّاسِ هَّا لَّمْ ي َّن ْس ُّ زْ لَّهَّا ذِي وَّ إن ي َّوْ مَّ إَّلْق ِي َّامَّ ه.
english_text:
The Imam {a.s} said:
"If a woman dies during childbirth (in her postpartum state), no record of her deeds
will be unfurled on the Day of Resurrection."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 139 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 271

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
arabic_text: َّوَّ ق َّال عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ: «مَّ وْ ب ُّ إَّلْع َّزِي ث ِ س َّ هَّاذَّة .
english_text:
The Imam {a.s} said:
"The death of a stranger (someone who dies away from their home) is martyrdom."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 139 • Shihab Al-Akhbar, Part 1, p. 29 • Sulwat al-Hazin, Part 1, p. 242 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 271 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 11, p. 347

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED

ُّ إ َّرْض ٍ ي َّمُّوب
۝»
ٍق َّق َّالَّ «مِن ْ ق َّذَّمٍ إ ِلَّى ق َّذَّم .
english_text:
The Imam {a.s} said regarding the words of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Glorious:
"No soul knows what it will earn tomorrow, and no soul knows in which land it will die"
(Surah Luqman 31:34).
Imam {a.s} said; "From one step to another."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 191 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol. 4, p. 382 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Part 4, p. 219 • Tafsir Kanz al-Daqa’iq, Part 10, p. 275

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال َّعَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ: «إ ِذ َّإ مَّ اب َّ إَّلْمُّو ْ مِن ُّ ن َّكَّث ْ عَّلَّي ْ هِ ن ِق َّاعُّ إَّلْأ َّرْض ِ إَّل َّي ِى كَّان َّ ي َّعْ ن ُّذُّ إَّلل َّهَّ عَّز َّ و ُّ ج َّ ل َّ ق ِي هَّا وَّ إَّلْن َّاب
ِإَّل َّذ ِى كَّان َّ ي َّصْ عَّذُّ مِن ْهُّ عَّمَّلُّهُّ وَّ مَّ وْ ص ِ غُّ سُّ ح ُّ وذِة .
english_text:
The Imam {a.s} said:
"When a believer dies, the places on earth where they used to worship Allah {SWT}, the
door through which their deeds would ascend, and their place of prostration weep for
them."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 139 • Al-Wafi, Part 1, p. 148 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 187 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Part 4, p. 629 • Tafseer Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Part 12, p. 131

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال ُّإَّلص َّ اذِق ُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
ِ «مَّ ن ْ عَّذ َّ ع َّذإً مِن ْ إ َّج َّ لِهِ ق َّق َّذْ إ َّسَّ اءَّ صُّ حْ ن َّه َّ إَّلْمَّوْ ب .
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "Whoever considers tomorrow
as part of their lifespan has not kept good company with death."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 139 • Tahaf al-Uqool, Part 1, p. 49 • Al-Majāzāt al- Nabawiyyah, Part 1, p. 198 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 191 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 437 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 74, p. 153

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
arabic_text:
ِوَّ ذَّج َّ لَّ رَّسُّ ولُّ إَّلل َّهِ صَّ ل َّى إَّلل َّهُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ وَّ إ لِهِ عَّلَّى ج َّ ذِي ح َّ ه َّ وَّ هِى َّ لِمَّا ن ِهَّا ق َّق َّالَّ لَّهُّ «ن ِالز َّع ْ مِ م ن َّا مَّ ا ن َّزَّى ن ِك ِ ي َّا
ُّ ج َّ ذِي ح َّ ه ِق َّا ِذ َّإ ق َّذِمْ ث ِ عَّلَّى ص َّ زَّإن ِزِك ِ ق َّا َّق ْزِن ِي هِن َّ إَّلس َّ لاَّمَّ» ق َّق َّالَّث ْ مَّ ن ْ هُّن َّ ي َّا رَّسُّ ولَّ إَّلل َّهِ ق َّالَّ « مَّ زْ ي َّمُّ إ ُّن ْن َّه ُّ عِ مْ زَّإن َّ وَّ كُّلْي ُّم
ِإ ُّج ْ ث ُّ مُّوسَّ ى وَّ إ سِ ي َّه ُّ إِمْ زَّإ َّة ُّ ق ِزْعَّوْ ن َّ » ق َّالَّث ْ ن ِالزِّق َّاءِ ي َّا رَّسُّ ولَّ إَّلل َّه.
english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} entered upon Khadijah {s.a} while she was
experiencing what she {s.a} was enduring (her final illness).
He {saws} said to her: "In spite of what we see happening to you, Khadijah {s.a}, when you
meet your co-wives in the Hereafter, give them my greetings of peace."
She {s.a} asked: "Who are they, O’ Messenger of Allah {saws}?"
He {saws} replied: "Mary {s.a}, the daughter of Imran {a.s}, and Kulthum {s.a}, the sister of Musa
{a.s}, and Asiya {s.a}, the wife of Pharaoh."
She {s.a} responded: "With pleasure, O’ Messenger of Allah {saws}."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 25, p. 570 • Tafsir al-Safi, Vol. 5, p. 199 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 19, p. 24 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Part 5, p. 376 • Tafseer Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Part 13, p.

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 140 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 271 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 11, p. 102 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 11, p. 347

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال ِرَّسُّ ولُّ إَّلل َّهِ صَّ ل َّى إَّلل َّهُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ وَّ إ لِه:
ُّ«كَّزَّإمَّ ه ُّ إَّلْمَّي ِّث ِ ي َّعْ ح ِ ي لُّه .
english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said:
"The honor of the deceased is their hastening (to be buried)."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 140 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 282 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 474

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال ِرَّسُّ ولُّ إَّلل َّهِ صَّ ل َّى إَّلل َّهُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ وَّ إ لِه :
ً«لأَّ إ ُّلْق ِي َّن َّ مِن ْكُّمْ رَّج ُّ لاً مَّ اب َّ لَّهُّ مَّ ي ِّث لَّي ْلاً ق َّان ْي َّط َّ زَّ ن ِهِ إَّلص ُّ ن ْحَّ وَّ لأَّ رَّج ُّ لا
َّمَّ اب َّ لَّهُّ مَّ ي ِّث ن َّهَّارإً ق َّان ْي َّط َّ زَّ ن ِهِ إَّلل َّي ْ لَّ لأَّ ي َّن ْي َّط ِ زُّوإ ن ِمَّوْ ي َّاكُّمْ طُّ لُّوعَّ إَّلس َّ مْ سِ وَّ لأَّ ع ُّزُّون َّهَّا ع َّ ح ِّ لُّوإ ن ِهِمْ إ ِلَّى مَّ ص ْاج ِ عِهِم
ُّي َّزْجَّ مُّكُّمُّ إَّلل َّهُّ» ق َّق َّالَّ إَّلن َّاسُّ وَّ إ َّن ْث َّ ي َّا رَّسُّ ولَّ إَّلل َّهِ ي َّزْجَّ مُّك َّ إَّلل َّه .
english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said: "I do not want to find among you a man whose
deceased loved one died at night and he waits until morning, or a man whose
deceased loved one died during the day and he waits until night. Do not wait for the
rising or setting of the sun with your dead. Hurry them to their resting places; may Allah
{SWT} have mercy on you."
The people replied: "And may Allah {SWT} have mercy on you, O’ Messenger of Allah
{saws}."
references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 137 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 140 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 427 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 281 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 471

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال ُّإ َّن ُّو ج َّ عْ ق َّزٍ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
«كَّان َّ ق ِي مَّا ن َّاج َّ ى ن ِهِ ، مُّوسَّ ى ن ْن ُّ عِ مْ زَّإن َّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ رَّن َّهُّ عَّز َّ وَّ ج َّ ل َّ إ َّن ْ ق َّالَّ ي َّا
ِرَّب ِّ مَّ ا ن َّلَّغ َّ مِن ْ عِ ي َّاذَّة ِ إَّلْمَّزِي ض ِ مِن َّ إَّلْأ َّج ْ زِ ق َّالَّ إ ُّوَّ كِّلُّ ن ِهِ مَّ لَّكاً ي َّعُّوذُّةُّ ق ِى ق َّن ْزِةِ إ ِلَّى مَّ حْ س َّ ز َّ ةِ ق َّالَّ ي َّا رَّب ِّ ق َّمَّا لِمَّن ْ ع َّسَّ ل
ُّإَّلْمَّوْ ي َّى ق َّالَّ إ َّع ْ سِ لُّهُّ مِن ْ ذ ُّن ُّون ِهِ كَّي َّوْ مَّ وَّ لَّذَّي ْهُّ إ ُّم ُّه .
english_text:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said: "In what Musa ibn Imran {a.s}
privately spoke to his Lord {AZJ}, the Mighty and Glorious,
Musa {a.s} said: 'O’ Lord {AZJ}, what is the reward for visiting the sick?'
Allah {SWT} replied: 'I will appoint an angel to visit them in their grave until the Day of
Resurrection.'
Musa {a.s} asked: 'O’ Lord {AZJ}, what about the one who washes the deceased?'
Allah {SWT} replied: 'I will cleanse them of their sins as on the day their mother gave birth
to them.'"
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال ِعَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ: «مَّ ن ْ ع َّس َّ لَّ مَّ ي ِّي اً مُّو ْ مِن اً ق َّا َّذ َّى ق ِي ه َّ إَّلْأ َّمَّ ان َّه َّ ع َّق َّزَّ إَّلل َّهُّ لَّهُّ» ق ِي لَّ وَّ كَّي ْف َّ ي ُّو َّ ذِّى ق ِي هِ إَّلْأ َّمَّ ان َّه
ُّ ق َّالَّ «لأَّ ي ُّح ْ ن ِزُّ ن ِمَّا ي َّزَّإةُّ وَّ جَّ ذ ُّةُّ إ ِلَّى إ َّن ْ ي ُّذْ ق َّن َّ إَّلْمَّي ِّث .
english_text:
The Imam {a.s} said:
"Whoever washes a deceased believer and fulfils the trust in that act, Allah {SWT} will
forgive them." It was asked: "How does one fulfil the trust in this matter?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "By not disclosing what they see and maintaining their duty until the
deceased is buried."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 141 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 496

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "Any believer who washes the
body of another believer and says while turning it:
'O’ Allah {SWT}, this is the body of Your believing servant; You have taken their soul from
it and separated them from each other, so forgive, forgive, forgive,'
Allah {SWT} will forgive the washer's sins for a year, except for major sins."
references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 164 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 141 • Thawab al-A’mal wa Iqab al-A’mal, Part 1, p. 195 • Al-Amali (by Al-Saduq) Vol. 1, p. 540 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 303 • Al- Waezin, Vol. 2, p. 489 • Sulwat al-Hazin, Part 1, p. 253 • Falah Al-Sael, Part 1, p. 78 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 285 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 494

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال ُّإَّلص َّ اذِق ُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
َّ «مَّ ا مِن ْ عَّن ْذٍ مُّو ْ مِن ٍ ي َّع ْ سِ لُّ مَّ ي ِّي اً مُّو ْ مِن اً وَّ ي َّق ُّولُّ وَّ هُّوَّ ي َّع ْ سِ لُّهُّ رَّب ِّ عَّق ْوَّ ك َّ عَّق ْوَّ ك
ُّإ ِلأ َّ عَّق َّا إَّلل َّهُّ عَّن ْه .
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"There is no believing servant who washes a deceased believer and says while washing
them:
'O’ Lord {AZJ}, Your forgiveness, Your forgiveness,' except that Allah {SWT} forgives them."
references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 164 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 141 • Falah Al-Sael, Part 1, p. 78 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 286 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 494 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 78, p. 300 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Vol. 2, p. 172

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال ُّإ َّمِي زُّ إَّلْمُّو ْ مِن ِي ن َّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
َّ «ي َّع ْ سِ لُّ إَّلْمَّي ِّث َّ إ َّوْ لَّى إَّلن َّاسِ ن ِهِ إ َّوْ مَّ ن ْ ي َّا ْمُّ زُّةُّ إَّلْوَّ لِى ُّ ن ِذ َّلِك.
english_text:
The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said:
"The one who washes the deceased should be the closest person to them or the one
whom the guardian (Wali) of the deceased appoints for this task."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 141 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 293 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 535

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Whoever washes a deceased person and conceals and keeps secret what they see,
they will emerge from their sins like the day their mother gave birth to them."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 141 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 496

english_text:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar wrote to Imam Hasan ibn Ali Al-Askari {a.s}
asking:
"What is the prescribed amount of water for washing the deceased, as it has been
narrated that the junub (one in a state of major ritual impurity) bathes with six ratls of
water and the menstruating woman with nine ratls of water ? Is there a prescribed
amount of water for washing the deceased?"
And Imam {a.s} replied in his own handwriting, saying: "The prescribed washing of the
deceased is to continue until they are purified, if Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, wills."
commentary:
This response was among a series of his responses that I possess in his handwriting
on a document.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 431 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 195 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 312 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 536

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
english_text:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"Water should not be heated for washing the deceased."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 322 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 328 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 1, p. 208 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 498 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 499 • Bihar Al- Anwar, Vol. 78, p. 295

It is also narrated in another hadith: "Except if it is a cold winter, in which case,
you should protect the deceased as you would protect yourself."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Do not leave your deceased alone, for Shaytan may disturb them within their body."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 142 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 282 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 466

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
english_text:
Ali ibn Ja'far asked his brother Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} about
washing the deceased in an open space.
Imam {a.s} replied: "There is no issue with it, but if they are covered with a curtain (for
privacy), that is more beloved to me."
references: Masa’il Ali ibn Ja’far, Part 1, p. 212 • Qurb al-Isnad, Part 1, p. 182 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 142 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 142 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 431 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 328 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 538 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 78, p. 288

ا ي َّق ْ عَّلُّ ذ َّلِك َّ إ َّهْلُّ إَّلْمَّزْإ َّة ِ كَّزَّإهِي َّه َّ إ َّن ْ ي َّن ْط ُّ زَّ ر َّوْ ج ُّ هَّا إ ِلَّى س َّ ى ْ ءٍ ي َّكْزَّهُّون َّهُّ مِن ْهَّا.
english_text:
Abdullah ibn Sinan asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about
whether it is permissible for a man to look at his wife when She dies or to wash her if
there is no one else to wash her, and likewise, if a woman can do the same for her
husband when he dies. Imam {a.s} replied:
"There is no issue with that. It is usually the woman's family who may dislike her
husband seeing something he would dislike about her."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 157 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 439 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 198 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 295 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 528

Chapter Title: WASHING OF THE DECEASED
arabic_text:
ِوَّ سُّ ن ِلَّ إَّلص َّ اذِق ُّ عَّلَّي ْ ه َّإَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ عَّن ْ ق َّاطِ مَّه َّ عَّلَّي ْهَّا إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ مَّ ن ْ ع َّسَّ لَّهَّا ق َّق َّالَّ «ع َّسَّ لَّهَّا إ َّمِي زُّ إَّلْمُّو ْ مِن ِي ن َّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لا ُّم
لِأ َّن َّهَّا كَّان َّث ْ صِ ذِّ ي ق َّه ً لَّمْ ي َّكُّن ْ لِي َّع ْ سِ لَّهَّا إ ِلأ َّ صِ ذِّ ي ق.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about about who
performed the washing (Ghusl) of (the body of) Sayyida Fatimah Al-Zahra {S.A}?"
Imam {a.s} said: "The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} performed
her washing because She was a ‘Al-Siddiqah’ (the most truthful and righteous one) ;
and her ghusl is not permitted except by a ‘Al-Siddiq’ (truthful and righteous person)."
commentary:
And whoever touches a piece of the body of a dead human devoured by animals; if he
has touched a bone, he must perform ghusl (ritual purification), but if there is no bone
present, there is no obligation for ghusl.
And whoever touches a dead creature must wash his hands, but he is not required to
perform the wash of touching; this obligation applies only to humans.
If someone touches a dead person before they have cooled (while their body is still
warm), they are not required to perform ghusl. However, if they touch them after the
body has cooled, they must perform ghusl. If the person is touched after the deceased
has been washed (ritually purified), there is no ghusl required.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

english_text:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"Touching a deceased person at the time of their death and after their washing, and
kissing them, is not an issue”.
commentary:
If one's clothing comes into contact with the body of the deceased, then they must
wash whatever part of the clothing was touched.
When preparing the deceased, the person washing starts by preparing the shroud.
They begin with a sheet (namat), spreading it out, then placing a "habrah" (a specific
cloth) and sprinkling some powdered perfume (dharirah) on it.
Next, they spread out the izar (waist cloth) on top of the habrah, sprinkling more of the
powdered perfume, then place the shirt (Qamis) on top of the izar, again sprinkling the
powdered perfume.
They take two fresh, green palm branches (Jaridatayn), each the length of
approximately a forearm, and if they are the length of an arm or a span, there is no
issue.
He writes on the Izar (wrap), Qamis (shirt), the habrah, and the two branches:
"So-and-so bears witness that there is no god but Allah {SWT}."
They then wrap all of it together.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 100 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 6, p. 430 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 295 PLACING THE JARIDATAYN

english_text:
Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about the reason for placing the palm branch
(jareedah with the deceased),
Imam {a.s} replied: "Indeed, the punishment is averted from them (the deceased) as
long as it remains fresh."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} passed by a grave where its occupant was being
punished. He requested a palm branch, split it into two halves, and placed one at the
head and the other at the feet of the grave.
It is narrated that the person in the grave was Qays ibn Fahd al-Ansari (in another
narration: Qays ibn Qumayr)
When asked why he placed the branches,
He {saws} replied: "Indeed, the punishment is lessened as long as they remain green."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 144 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 387

. إ مكن
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about placing the palm
branch (jareedah) in the grave,
Imam {a.s} replied: "There is no issue (with it)”.
commentary:
It means that if Jaridatayn were found after the deceased has been buried in their grave
or if someone is present from whom taqiyya is necessary, and thus it is not possible
that the Jaridatayn be placed inside the shroud as reported; instead, they should be
placed with the deceased however possible.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 153 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 328 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 385 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 28 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 28

ٍ رَّطْ ث.
.ومي ى جص ز ع سل إلمي ث ق وم مح الق ون وج ث إ ن ي ق غ إلأج ي هاذ ق ى إ ن ي ع سل ع سل إلمو من وي ح ق ى إلح زي ذة عن هم
english_text:
Ali ibn Bilal wrote to Abu Al-Hasan al-Third, Imam Ali ibn Muhammad Al-Hadi
{a.s}:
"A man dies in a land where there are no palm trees. Is it permissible to use something
from other trees instead of the palm branch?
It has been narrated from your forefathers {a.s} that 'the punishment is averted as long
as the two palm branches remain fresh, and that it benefits both the believer and the
disbeliever.'"
Imam {a.s} replied: "It is permissible to use fresh branches from another tree."
commentary:
And if people of opposing beliefs are present during the washing of the deceased,
efforts should be made to ensure that the deceased is washed according to the rites
of a believer, and the placement of the branches should be concealed from them.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

َّ ق َّق َّالَّ «إ ِن َّ رَّج ُّ لاً مِن َّ إَّلْأ َّن ْصَّ ارِ هَّلَّك َّ ق َّا ُّوذ ِن َّ رَّسُّ ولُّ إَّلل َّهِ صَّ ل َّى إَّلل َّهُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ وَّ إ لِهِ ن ِمَّوْ ي ِهِ ق َّق الَّ لِمَّن ْ ي َّلِي هِ مِن ْ ق َّزَّإن َّي ِهِ «ج َّ ص ِّ زُّوإ

» ِ إ ِلَّى إ َّصْ لِ إَّلي َّزْق ُّوَّ ة .
english_text:
It was narrated from Yahya ibn 'Abbad al-Makki that He said:
"I heard Sufyan al-Thawri asking Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} about 'al-
takhdir' (placing green branches).
Imam {a.s} replied: 'A man from the Ansar died, and the Messenger of Allah {saws} was
informed of his death. He said to those from the man's relatives who were responsible
for him, "Place greenery (al-takhdir) on your companion. How few are those who will
be adorned with greenery on the Day of Resurrection."'
Sufyan asked: 'What is al-takhdir?'
Imam {a.s} said: "A green palm branch that is placed from the base of the hands to the
base of the collarbone."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
english_text:
Al-Hasan ibn Ziyad asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about the
palm branch that is placed with the deceased.
Imam {a.s} replied: "It benefits both the believer and the disbeliever”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال ُّ ر ُّرَّإرَّة:
« َّق ُّلْث ُّ لِأ َّن ِى ج َّ عْ ق َّزٍ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ إ َّ رَّإ َّي ْث َّ إَّلْمَّي ِّث َّ إ ِذ َّإ مَّ اب َّ لِمَّ ي ُّح ْ عَّلُّ مَّ عَّهُّ إَّلْح َّ زِي ذَّة ُّ ق َّق َّال ي َّي َّح َّ اق َّى
َّعَّن ْهُّ إَّلْعَّذ َّإب ُّ وَّ إَّلْحِ سَّ اب ُّ مَّ ا ذَّإمَّ إَّلْعُّوذُّ رَّطْ ن اً إ ِن َّمَّا إَّلْحِ سَّ اب ُّ وَّ إَّلْعَّذ َّإب ُّ كُّل ُّهُّ ق ِى ي َّوْ مٍ و إجِ ذٍ ق ِى سَّ اعَّه ٍ وَّ إجِ ذَّة ٍ ق َّذْ رَّ مَّ ا
ي ُّذْ ج َّ لُّ إَّلْق َّن ْزَّ وَّ ي َّزْج ِ غُّ إَّلْق َّوْ مُّ وَّ إ ِن َّمَّا ج ُّ عِلَّث ِ إَّلس َّ عَّق َّي َّان ِ لِذ َّلِك َّ ق َّلاَّ ي ُّصِ ي ن ُّهُّ عَّذ َّإب وَّ لأَّ جِ سَّ ا ُّب ن َّعْ ذَّ ج ُّ ق ُّوق ِهِمَّا إ ِن ْ س َّ اءَّ إَّلل َّه
ي َّعَّالَّى .
english_text:
Zurarah said: I asked Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}: "Why is a palm
branch placed with the deceased?"
Imam {a.s} said:
"The punishment and accounting (in the grave) are averted from them as long as the
branch remains fresh.
The entire accounting and punishment occur in a single day and a single moment -
during the time it takes for the deceased to be placed in the grave and for the people
to return.
The two palm branches were placed for this reason, so no punishment or accounting
will afflict the deceased after they have dried up, if Allah {SWT} wills."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 152 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 145 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 383 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 20 • Al-Fusul al-Muhimmah, Part 2, p. 37 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 6, p. 215 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Part 3, p. 556 • Tafseer Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol. 9, p.

english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Be meticulous in choosing the shrouds, for they will be resurrected in them."
references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 149 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 146 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 449 • Falah Al-Sael, Part 1, p. 69 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 374 • Tafsir al-Safi, Part 2, p. 140 • Wasail Al- Shia, Part 3, p. 39 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 39 • Al-Fusul al-Muhimmah, Part 1, p. 340 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 7, p. 43

Chapter Title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
arabic_text: َّوَّ ق َّال َّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ: «إ َّج ِ ي ذُّوإ إ َّكْق َّان ْمَّ وْ ي َّاكُّمْ ق َّا ِن َّهَّا ر ِي ن َّي ُّهُّم .
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Make the shrouds of your deceased good, for they are their adornment."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 148 • Thawab al-A’mal wa Iqab al- A’mal, Part 1, p. 197 • Ilal al-Sharai’ Vol. 1, p. 301 • Sulwat al-Hazin, Part 1, p. 254 • Falah Al-Sael, Part 1, p. 69 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 373 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 39 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 40 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 78, p. 312

arabic_text:

«إ ِذ َّإ كَّق َّن ْث َّ إَّلْمَّي ِّث َّ ق َّا ِن ِ إِسْ ي َّطَّ عْ ث َّ إ َّن ْ ي َّكُّون َّ ق ِى كَّق َّن ِهِ ي َّوْ ب كَّان َّ ي ُّصَّ لِّى
ِق ِي هِ ن َّط ِ ي ق اً ق َّاق ْعَّلْ ق َّا ِن َّهُّ ي ُّسْ ي َّحَّ ث ُّ إ َّن ْ ي ُّكَّق َّن َّ ق ِي مَّا كَّان َّ ي ُّصَّ لِّى ق ِي ه.
ولأ ي ح ور إ ن ي كق ن إلمي ث ق ى كي ان ولأ إ ن زي سم، ولكن ق ى إلق طن.
english_text:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said: "If you shroud the deceased, and
you are able to include in their shroud a garment that they used to pray in and it is
clean, then do so. It is recommended that they be shrouded in what they used to pray
in”.
commentary:
Additionally, it is not permissible to shroud the deceased in linen or silk, but only in
cotton.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 149 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 434 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 210 • Taʿziyat al-Ḥazānā, Part 1, p. 255 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 374 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 42

ِإ لِه .
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "Linen was used by the Children
of Israel for shrouding, while cotton is for the Ummah (community) of Muhammad."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 149 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 435 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 211 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 378 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 45

english_text:
Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} was asked about a man who had
purchased part of the covering of the Kaaba (Kiswah) and used some of it to fulfil a
need, while some of it remained with him. He was asked whether it was permissible
to sell the remaining part.
Imam {a.s} said: "He may sell what he wants, give away what he does not need, use it,
and seek its blessings."
He was then asked if it was permissible to shroud a deceased person in it
Imam {a.s} said: "No."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال ُّإَّلص َّ اذِق ُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
ٍ«ي َّن ْن َّع ِى إ َّن ْ ي َّكُّون َّ إَّلْق َّمِي ضُّ لِلْمَّي ِّث ِ ع َّي ْ زَّ مَّ كْق ُّوف ٍ وَّ لأَّ مُّ ز َّر َّر .
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"The shirt (Qamis) for the deceased should be without cuffs and without buttons."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 147 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 370 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 51

english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about whether a man
should be shrouded in his shirt (Qamis).
Imam {a.s} said: "Remove its buttons."
I asked: "And the sleeves?"
Imam {a.s} said: "No, that is only necessary if it is made new for him, in which case it
should have no sleeves. However, if it is an already-worn garment, only the buttons
need to be removed."
commentary:
After the shrouding is prepared, the deceased is placed on the washing platform facing
the Qiblah, and the shirt is removed from above down to the waist, leaving it in place
until the washing is complete to cover the 'awrah’ (private parts). If there is no shirt, a
covering is placed over the private parts.
He gently and softly extends his fingers; if it becomes difficult (due to rigor mortis), he
leaves it.
The hands are passed gently over the abdomen, then washing begins.
He begins with the hands: The hands are washed three times with water containing
sidr (lotus leaves).
He wraps a cloth around his own left hand and places some of the ‘Hirad ‘ (type of soap
alkali plant/cleansing agent) on it, and he reaches his hand under the garment
(covering the privates) and another person pours water from above to his navel,
washing his front and back (of privates) without cutting off the water.
Then he washes his head and beard with the lather (froth) of sidr, followed by three
washings with water. The deceased is not seated during the process.
The body is turned to the left side to expose the right side, and the right arm is extended
along the body. The body is washed three times with water from head to toe.
The process is then repeated on the left side ; he turns him to his right side so that his
left side becomes visible, and he extends his left hand to his left side where he has
reached, then he washes him with three pots from his head to his foot.
After the washing, the abdomen is gently massaged, and a second washing is
performed with water mixed with a small amount of camphor, similar to the first wash.
Then he rinses the vessels containing the camphor water and a third washing with pure
water is performed without massaging the abdomen again.
During the washing, say the supplication:
"O’ Allah {SWT}, Your pardon, Your pardon," and if this is done, Allah {SWT} forgives the
deceased.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 1, p. 305 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 370 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 51

english_text:
Archangel Jibril {a.s}, brought to the Prophet Muhammad {saws} an ounce of
camphor from Paradise. An ounce in this context is equivalent to forty dirhams. The
Prophet {saws} divided it into three parts: one part for himself, one part for Imam Ali {a.s},
and one part for Sayyida Fatimah Al-Zahra {S.A}.
commentary:
For someone who cannot afford the weight of thirteen dirhams and one-third of
camphor, the deceased should be embalmed with four mithqals (about 14 grams), If
that is not possible, at least one mithqal (about 3.5 grams) should be used, as it is
necessary.
The Hunut (anointing with camphor) of a deceased man and a deceased woman is the
same, and it is disliked that he use incense or follow the body with a censer, but the
shroud is to be incensed (there is no harm in that).
The camphor is to be daubed/applied to his eyes, nostrils, ears, lips, hands, knees,
and all his joints, as well as on the places of prostration. If there is any remaining, it is
placed on the chest.
After completing the third washing of the deceased, the washer should wash their
hands from the elbows to the fingers and cover the deceased with a cloth to dry the
water.
The water from the washing of the deceased must not be disposed of in a latrine or
well ; it should instead be directed to drains or a pit.
The deceased's nails should not be clipped, nor their mustache trimmed, nor any hair
cut. If anything falls from the body, it should be included with the shroud.
The washer then performs ablution, followed by a full-body wash, before placing the
deceased in the shroud.
Two palm stalks are placed with the deceased : one by the collarbone touching the
skin and extending over the right side, and the other at the hip on the left side, between
the shirt and the lower garment.
The deceased is then wrapped in a shroud, with the left side folded over the right and
vice versa. If desired, the upper shroud can be placed after the deceased is put in the
grave, and they are then wrapped in a cloth, with the turban not tied like an Arab’s
customary style, but rather having its ends placed on the chest.
Before putting on the shirt, cotton mixed with ground fragrant herbs is placed around
the lower body. Cotton is also placed over the front, with the legs pressed together and
the thighs bound tightly with the lower garment to prevent anything from leaving the
body.
When the shrouding is complete, the embalming (Hunut) described earlier is
performed. The body is then placed on a bier and carried to the grave.
No one should say "Be gentle with him" or "Have mercy on him," nor strike their thighs
in mourning, lest their reward is lost.
If anything leaves the body after washing, the washing is not repeated; instead, the
affected area of the shroud is cleaned until placed in the grave. If any discharge occurs
in the grave, the affected part of the shroud is to be trimmed, and one of the other
garments should be laid over the other.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 149 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 14

Chapter Title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال ِإَّلص َّ اذِق ُّ عَّلَّي ْ ه ُّإَّلس َّ لاَّم:
ً«مَّ ن ْ كَّق َّن َّ مُّو ْ مِن اً ق َّكَّا َّن َّمَّا ص َّ مِن َّ كِسْ وَّ ي َّهُّ إ ِلَّى ي َّوْ مِ إَّلْق ِي َّامَّ ه ِ وَّ مَّ ن ْ جَّ ق َّزَّ لِمُّو ْ مِن ٍ ق َّن ْزإ
ِ ق َّكَّا َّن َّمَّا ن َّو َّإ َّةُّ ن َّي ْي اً مُّوَّ إق ِق اً إ ِلَّى ي َّوْ مِ إَّلْق ِي َّامَّ ه.
. وإلح ن ث إ ذ إ ماب ع سل ع سلا وجذإ ي ح ز ى عن ه لح ن ان ي ه ولع سل إلمي ث لأ ن هما جزمي ان إج ي معي ا ق ى جزمه وإجذة
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Whoever shrouds a believer, it is as if they have guaranteed their clothing until the
Day of Resurrection. And whoever digs a grave for a believer, it is as if they have
prepared for them a suitable dwelling until the Day of Resurrection."
commentary:
Regarding a person who dies in a state of major ritual impurity (janabah), one washing
suffices for both removing the state of impurity and the washing of the deceased, as
these two obligations converge into a single sanctity.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
arabic_text:
ِوَّ سَّ ا َّلَّ إ َّن ُّو إَّلْح َّ ارُّوذِ إ َّن َّا ج َّ عْ ق َّزٍ عَّلَّي ْ ه ُّإَّلس َّ لاَّم:
ُّعَّن ِ إَّلز َّج ُّ لِ ي ُّي َّوَّ ق َّى إ َّ ي ُّق َّل َّمُّ إ َّط َّ اق ِي زُّةُّ وَّ ي ُّن ْي َّف ُّ إ ِن ْطَّ اةُّ وَّ ي ُّحْ لَّق ُّ عَّان َّي ُّه
َّإ ِن ْ طَّ الَّث ْ ن ِهِ مِن َّ إَّلْمَّزَّض ِ ق َّق َّالَّ «لأ .
وإ ذ إ إ سق طث إلمزإ ة وكان إلسق ظ ي اما ع سل جن ظ وكق ن وذق ن ، وإ ن لم ي كن ي اما ق لا ع سل علي ه وي ذق ن ن ذمه، وجذ ي مامه
.إ ذ إ إ ي ى علي ه إ رن عه إ س هز
وإلكق ن إلمق زوض ي لاي ه : ق مي ض وإ ر إر ولق اق ه سوى إلعمامه وإلح زق ه ق لا ي عذإن من إلكق ن ق من إ جث إ ن ي ز ي ذ ر إذ لق اق ي ي ن
جي ى ي ن لغ إلعذذ ج مسه إ ي وإب ق لا ن ا س.
english_text:
Abu al-Jaroud asked Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} about a man who
passed away: Should his nails be trimmed, his armpit hair plucked, or his pubic hair
shaved if he had been bedridden for a long period? Imam {a.s} said: "No."
commentary:
Regarding a woman who has a miscarriage, if the fetus is fully formed, it should be
washed, embalmed, shrouded, and buried. If it is not fully formed, it does not require
washing and is to be buried with its blood. The criterion for a fetus being fully formed
is when it reaches four months (from conception).
The obligatory shroud (Kafan) consists of three pieces: a shirt (Qamis), a loincloth
(izar), and an outer covering (lifafah). The turban and cloth used for binding are not
considered part of the required shroud, but for those who wish to add more, it is
permissible to use up to five cloths.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
arabic_text:
ِ وَّ كُّق ِّن َّ إَّلن َّن ِى ُّ صَّ ل َّى إَّلل َّهُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ وَّ إ لِهِ ق ِى ي َّلاَّي َّه ِ إ َّي ْوَّ إب ٍ ق ِى ن ُّزْذَّي َّي ْن ِ ط َّ ق ِزِي َّي َّي ْن ِ مِن ْ ي ِي َّاب ٍ إَّلْي َّمَّن ِ وَّ ي َّوْ ب ِ كُّزْسُّ ف
ٍ وَّ هُّوَّ ي َّوْ ب ُّ ق ُّطْ ن .
english_text:
"The Prophet, was shrouded in three garments: two pieces of Yemeni cloth
known as "Zafariyyah" and a garment made of cotton ‘Kursaf’ cloth."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 152 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 362 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 12

Chapter Title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
arabic_text: َّوَّ رُّوِى َّ: «إ َّن َّهُّ جُّ ن ِّظ ِن ِمِي ْق َّالِ مِسْ ك ٍ سِ وَّ ى إَّلْكَّاق ُّور .
english_text:
It is reported that the Prophet Muhammad {saws} was embalmed with a mithqal
(a specific weight) of musk in addition to camphor.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 152 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 316

Chapter Title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال ُّإَّلص َّ اذِق ُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
ُّ«كَّي َّث َّ إ َّن ِى عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ ق ِى وَّ صِ ي َّي ِهِ إ َّن ْ إ ُّكَّق ِّن َّهُّ ق ِى ي َّلاَّي َّه ِ إ َّي ْوَّ إب ٍ إ َّجَّ ذُّهَّا ن ُّزْذ لَّه
جِ ن َّزَّة كَّان َّ ي ُّصَّ لِّى ق ِي هِ ي َّوْ مَّ إَّلْح ُّ مُّعَّه ِ وَّ ي َّوْ ب إ ج َّ زُّ وَّ ق َّمِي ض .
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "My father {a.s} wrote in his will
that I should shroud him in three garments: one of them being a Yemeni cloth (hibarah)
that he used to wear for Jumu’ah prayers, along with another cloth and a shirt
(Qamis)."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
arabic_text:
ُّوَّ سُّ ن ِلَّ مُّوسَّ ى ن ْن ُّ ج َّ عْ ق َّزٍ عَّلَّي ْهِمَّا إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
َّعَّن ِ إَّلز َّج ُّ لِ ي َّمُّوب ُّ إ َّ ي ُّكَّق َّن ُّ ق ِى ي َّلاَّي َّه ِ إ َّي ْوَّ إب ٍ ن ِع َّي ْ زِ ق َّمِي ضٍ ق َّالَّ «لأ
َّ ن َّا ْسَّ ن ِذ َّلِك َّ وَّ إَّلْق َّمِي ضُّ إ َّجَّ ث ُّ إ ِلَّى .
english_text:
Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} was asked about a man who dies and
whether he can be shrouded in three garments without a shirt (Qamis).
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no problem with that, but having a shirt is more preferred to
me."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
arabic_text:
وَّ سَّ ا َّلَّ عَّم َّارُّ ن ْن ُّ مُّوسَّ ى إَّلس َّ ان َّاطِ ى ُّ إ َّن َّا ُّعَّن ْذِ إَّلل َّهِ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
ُّعَّن ِ إَّلْمَّزْإ َّة ِ إ ِذ َّإ مَّ اي َّث ْ ق ِى ن ِق َّاسِ هَّا كَّي ْف َّ ي ُّع َّس َّ ل
ًق َّالَّ «ي ُّع َّس َّ لُّ مِي ْلَّ مَّ ا ي ُّع َّس َّ لُّ إَّلط َّ اهِزَّة ُّ وَّ كَّذ َّلِك َّ إَّلْحَّ ان ِض ُّ وَّ كَّذ َّلِك َّ إَّلْح ُّ ن ُّث ُّ إ ِن َّمَّا ي ُّع َّس َّ لُّ ع ُّسْ لا
ًوَّ إجِ ذإ .
english_text:
Ammar ibn Musa al-Sabati asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}
about a woman who dies in a state of postpartum bleeding (nifas).
Imam {a.s} said: "She is washed just like a pure woman is washed, as is the case for a
menstruating woman or someone in a state of major ritual impurity (janabah). They are
washed with one washing."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
english_text:
Abu Al-Hasan al-Thalith, Imam Ali ibn Muhammad Al-Hadi {a.s} was asked
whether musk and incense (bukhoor) should be brought near the deceased.
Imam {a.s} replied: "Yes."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"If a woman dies in a state of postpartum bleeding (nifas) and her bleeding is heavy,
She is washed up to the navel using a leather garment or something similar.
Then She is cleaned thoroughly, and cotton is placed in the front and back (private
areas), and She is shrouded afterward."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 153 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 24, p. 334

Chapter Title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
arabic_text:
ُّوَّ سُّ ن ِلَّ إَّلص َّ اذِق ُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
عَّن ِ إَّلْمَّزْإ َّة ِ ي َّمُّوب ُّ مَّ غَّ رِج َّ الٍ لَّي ْ سَّ مَّ عَّهُّمْ ذ ُّو مَّ حْ زَّمٍ هَّلْ ي ُّع َّسِّ لُّون َّهَّا وَّ عَّلَّي ْهَّا ي ِي َّان ُّهَّا
ق َّق َّالَّ «إ ِذ إً ي ُّذْ ج َّ لَّ ذ َّلِك َّ عَّلَّي ْهِمْ وَّ لَّكِن ْ ي َّع ْ سِ لُّون َّ كَّق َّي ْهَّا .
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about a woman who
passes away among a group of men with no male relative (mahram) present. Should
they wash her while She remains clothed?
Imam {a.s} replied: "If they do that, it will be burdensome for them. Rather, they should
wash only her hands."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
arabic_text:
ٍوَّ سَّ ا َّلَّهُّ عَّن ْذُّ إَّلل َّهِ ن ْن ُّ إ َّن ِى ي َّعْ ق ُّور:
َّ عَّن ِ إَّلز َّج ُّ لِ ي َّمُّوب ُّ ق ِى إَّلس َّ ق َّزِ مَّ غَّ إَّلن ِّسَّ اءِ وَّ لَّي ْ سَّ مَّ عَّهُّن َّ رَّج ُّ ل كَّي ْف َّ ي َّصْ ن َّعْ ن
ُّن ِهِ ق َّالَّ «ي َّلْق ُّق ْن َّهُّ لَّق اً ق ِى ي ِي َّان ِهِ وَّ ي َّذْ ق ِن َّهُّ وَّ لأَّ ي ُّع َّسِّ لْن َّه.
english_text:
Abdullah ibn Abi Ya’fur asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about a
man who dies while traveling in the company of women, with no other men present.
What should they do?
Imam {a.s} replied: "They should wrap him in his clothes and bury him without washing
him."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
arabic_text:

ِ» وَّ إَّلز َّج ُّ لُّ ي َّمُّوب ُّ وَّ لَّي ْ سَّ مَّ عَّهُّ إ ِلأ َّ إَّلن ِّسَّ اءُّ لَّي ْسَّ مَّ عَّهُّن َّ رِج َّ ال ق َّالَّ «ي َّذْ ق ِن َّهُّ كَّمَّا هُّوَّ ن ِي ِي َّان ِه .
english_text:
Al-Halabi asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about a woman who
dies while traveling, with no male relative (mahram) or other women present.
Imam {a.s} replied: "She should be buried as She is, in her clothes”.
He (Halabi) asked; Regarding a man who dies with only women present and no other
men.
Imam said: "They should bury him as he is, in his clothes."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 154 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 2, p. 520

Chapter Title: CHAPTER ON TOUCHING THE DECEASED
arabic_text:
وَّ سَّ ا َّلَّهُّ إ َّن ُّو َّ إَّلن ُّمَّي ْ زِ مَّ وْ لَّى إَّلْحَّ ارِب ِ ن ْن ِ إَّلْمُّع ِي زَّة ِ ق َّق َّالَّ: جَّ ذِّ ي ْن ِى عَّن ِ إَّلص َّ ن ِى ِّ إ ِلَّى كَّمْ ي ُّع َّسِّ لُّهُّ إَّلن ِّسَّ اءُّ ق ق َّالَّ «إ ِلَّى
