The Messenger of Allah {saws} said:
"Whoever leads a people in prayer while there is someone among them who is more
knowledgeable than him, their affairs will continue to decline until the Day of
Judgment."
commentary:
Abu Dharr said:
"Indeed, your Imam is your intercessor with Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, so do
not make your intercessor a foolish person or a transgressor."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
ُّ وَّ رَّوَّ ى إَّلْحُّ سَّ ي ْن ُّ ن ْن ُّكَّي ِي زٍ عَّن ْ إ َّن ِى عَّن ْذِ إَّلل َّهِ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
َّإ َّن َّهُّ سَّ ا َّلَّهُّ رَّج ُّ ل عَّن ِ إَّلْق ِزَّإءَّة ِ ج َّ لْف َّ إَّلْأ ِمَّ امِ ق َّق َّالَّ «لأ
ُّ إ ِن َّ إَّلْأ ِمَّ امَّ ص َّ امِن لِلْق ِزَّإءَّة ِ وَّ لَّي ْ سَّ ي َّص ْ مَّن ُّ إَّلْأ ِمَّ امُّ صَّ لاَّة َّ إَّل َّذ ِي ن َّ هُّمْ مِن ْ ج َّ لْق ِهِ إ ِن َّمَّا ي َّص ْ مَّن َّ إَّلْق ِزَّإءَّة .
english_text:
Al-Hussain ibn Kathir narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}
that a man asked him about reciting (Qur'an) behind the Imam (during prayer).
Imam {a.s} said: "No, the Imam is responsible for the recitation, but the Imam does not
take responsibility for the prayers of those behind him; he is only responsible for the
recitation."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 378 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 279 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 440 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1251 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 353 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 354 • Al- Fusul al-Muhimmah, Part 2, p. 122 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 85, p. 252

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
َّوَّ رَّوَّ ى مُّحَّ م َّذُّ ن ْن ُّ مُّسْ لِمٍ عَّن ْ إ َّن ِى ج َّ عْ ق َّزٍ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ إ َّن َّهُّ ق َّالَّ: «ج َّ مْ سَّ ه لأَّ ي َّو ُّم ُّون َّ إَّلن َّاسَّ و ْ لأَّ ي ُّصَّ ل ُّون َّ ن ِهِم
َّصَّ لاَّة ً ق َّزِي ص َّ ه ً ق ِى ج َّ مَّاعَّه ٍ إَّلْأ َّن ْزَّضُّ و ُّإَّلْمَّح ْ ذ ُّومُّ وَّ وَّ لَّذُّ إَّلز ِّن َّا وَّ إَّلْأ َّعْ زَّإن ِى ُّ جَّ ي َّى ي ُّهَّاج ِ زَّ وَّ إَّلْمَّحْ ذُّوذ .
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s}
who said:
"Five people should not lead others in prayer nor should they lead them in a
congregational obligatory prayer: the person with leprosy (abrāṣ), the person with a
skin disease (majdhūm), the child of adultery (walad al-zina), the Bedouin (a‘rābī) until
he migrates, and the person who has been subjected to the legal punishment (al-
maḥdūd)."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 378 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1175 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 324

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال ُّإ َّمِي زُّ إَّلْمُّو ْ مِن ِي ن َّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
َّ«لأَّ ي ُّصَّ لِّي َّن َّ إ َّجَّ ذُّكُّمْ ج َّ لْف َّ إَّلْأ َّج ْ ذ َّمِ وَّ إَّلْأ َّن ْزَّضِ وَّ إَّلْمَّح ْ ن ُّون ِ وَّ إَّلْمَّحْ ذُّوذِ و
َّوَّ لَّذِ إَّلز ِّن َّا وَّ إَّلْأ َّعْ زَّإن ِى ُّ لأَّ ي َّو ُّم ُّ إَّلْمُّهَّاج ِ ز .
english_text:
The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said:
"None of you should pray behind a person with a mutilated limb (al-ajdham), a person
with leprosy (al-abrāṣ), a person with a mental disorder (al-majnūn), a person who has
been subjected to a legal punishment (al-maḥdūd), the child of adultery (walad al-
zina), or a Bedouin (al-a‘rābī) leading a migrant (al-muhājir)."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 378 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 325

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
english_text:
Imam {a.s} said: "An uncircumcised man (al-aghlaf) should not lead the people
in prayer, even if he is the most proficient in reciting the Qur'an among them, because
he has neglected one of the greatest aspects of the Sunnah. His testimony is not
accepted, and prayers are not performed over him unless he left it (circumcision) out
of fear for his life."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 378 • Ilal al-Sharai’ Vol. 2, p. 327 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 30 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1184 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 320 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 78, p. 344 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 85, p. 84 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol. 101, p. 112

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال ُّإَّلص َّ اذِق ُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
َّ«لأَّ ي َّو ُّم ُّ صَّ اجِ ث ُّ إَّلْق َّي ْذِ إَّلْمُّطْ لَّق ِي ن َّ وَّ لأَّ ي َّو ُّم ُّ صَّ اجِ ث ُّ إَّلْق َّالِح ِ إَّلْأ َّصِ ح َّ اء .
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"A person in chains (al-qayd) does not lead those who are free, and a person afflicted
with paralysis (al-falij) does not lead those who are healthy."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال ُّإَّلْن َّاق ِزُّ وَّ إَّلص َّ اذِق ُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
ْ«لأَّ ن َّا ْسَّ إ َّن ْ ي َّو ُّم َّ إَّلْأ َّعْ مَّى إ ِذ َّإ رَّص ُّ وإ ن ِهِ وَّ كَّان َّ إ َّكْي َّزَّهُّمْ ق ِزَّإءَّة ً وَّ إ َّق ْق َّهَّهُّم.
english_text:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} and Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-
Sadiq {a.s} said:
"There is no issue for a blind person to lead the prayer if the people (praying behind
him) are satisfied with him and he is the best among them in recitation and the most
knowledgeable in religious jurisprudence."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 379 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 338

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال ُّإ َّن ُّو ج َّ عْ ق َّزٍ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
ُّ «إ ِن َّمَّا إَّلْأ َّعْ مَّى إ َّعْ مَّى إَّلْق َّلْث ِ ق َّا ِن َّهَّا «لأٰ ي َّعْ مَّى إَّلْأ َّن ْصٰ ارُّ وَّ لٰكِن ْ ي َّعْ مَّى إَّلْق ُّلُّوب
»ِإَّل َّي ِى ق ِى إَّلص ُّ ذُّور »
english_text:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"Indeed, the truly blind are those who are blind in their hearts, for it is not the eyes that
go blind but the hearts within the chests."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 379 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 338 • Tafsir Nur Al- Thaqalayn, Part 3, p. 508 • Tafseer Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol. 9, p. 117

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال ُّإَّلص َّ اذِق ُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
ُّ«ي َّلاَّي َّه لأَّ ي ُّصَّ ل َّى ج َّ لْق َّهُّمُّ إَّلْمَّح ْ هُّولُّ وَّ إَّلْع َّالِى وَّ إ ِن ْ كَّان َّ ي َّق ُّولُّ ن ِق َّوْ لِك َّ وَّ إَّلْمُّح َّ اهِز
ًن ِالْق ِسْ ق ِ وَّ إ ِن ْ كَّان َّ مُّق ْي َّصِ ذإ .
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Three people should not be prayed behind: the one who is unknown (al-majhūl), the
extremist (al-ghālī) even if he claims to hold your beliefs, and the one who openly
commits sinful acts (al-mujāhir bil-fisq) even if he appears moderate."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 379 • Al-Khisal, Part 1, p. 154 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1181 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 314 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 85, p. 23 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Vol. 6, p. 463

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال ُّ عَّلِى ُّ ن ْن ُّمُّ حَّ م َّذٍ وَّ مُّ حَّ م َّذُّ ن ْن ُّ عَّلِى ٍّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
َّ«مَّ ن ْ ق َّالَّ ن ِالْح ِ سْ مِ ق َّلاَّ ي ُّعْ طُّ وةُّ س َّ ي ْن اً مِن َّ إَّلز َّكَّاة ِ وَّ لأ
ُّي ُّصَّ ل ُّوإ ج َّ لْق َّه .
english_text:
Imam Ali ibn Muhammad al-Hadi {a.s} and Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Jawad
{a.s} said:
"Whoever believes in anthropomorphism (al-jism), do not give them anything from the
zakat, and do not pray behind them."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 379 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 311 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 85, p. 74

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
ُّوَّ كَّي َّث َّ إ َّن ُّو عَّن ْذِ إَّلل َّهِ إَّلْن َّزْق ِى ُّ إ ِلَّى إ َّن ِى ج َّ عْ ق َّزٍ إَّلي َّان ِى عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
ْ إ َّ ي َّح ُّ ور ُّ ج ُّ عِلْث ُّ ق ِذَّإك َّ إَّلص َّ لاَّة ُّ ج َّ لْف َّ مَّ ن
ُّوَّ ق َّف َّ عَّلَّى إ َّن ِي ك َّ وَّ ج َّ ذِّ ك َّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ ق َّا َّج َّ اب َّ «لأَّ ي ُّصَّ لِّ وَّ رَّإءَّة .
english_text:
Abu Abdullah al-Barqi wrote to Abu Ja'far al-Thani {a.s}, asking:
"May I be your ransom, is it permissible to pray behind someone who stopped at (only
accepted the Imamate of) your father and grandfather {a.s}?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Do not pray behind him."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 379 • Awalim al-Ulum, Vol. 23, p. 402

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
ُّوَّ سَّ ا َّلَّ عُّمَّزُّ ن ْن ُّ ي َّز ِي ذَّ إ َّن َّا عَّن ْذِ إَّلل َّهِ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
ُّعَّن ْ إ ِمَّ امٍ لأَّ ن َّا ْسَّ ن ِهِ ق ِى ج َّ مِي غِ إ ُّمُّورِةِ عَّارِف ٍ ع َّي ْ زَّ إ َّن َّهُّ ي ُّسْ مِغ
إ َّن َّوَّ ي ْ هِ إَّلْكَّلاَّمَّ إَّلْع َّلِي ظ َّ إَّل َّذ ِى ي َّع ِي ط ُّ هُّمَّا إ َّق ْزَّإ ُّ ج َّ لْق َّهُّ ق َّالَّ «لأَّ، ي َّق ْ زَّإ ُّ ج َّ لْق َّهُّ مَّ ا لَّمْ ي َّكُّن ْ عَّاق ًاً ق َّاطِ عا .
english_text:
Umar ibn Yazid asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about an Imam
who is generally good in all his affairs and knowledgeable, but he raises his voice and
speaks harshly to his parents, causing them distress.
He asked: "Should I pray behind him?"
He {a.s} replied: "No, do not pray behind him as long as he is not openly defiant and
severing ties”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 379 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 30 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1180 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 313 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 71, p. 44 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 85, p. 40

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Halabi narrated from him {a.s} that He said:
"Do not pray behind someone who declares you to be an unbeliever (kafir), and do not
pray behind someone whom you have declared to be an unbeliever."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 380 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1182 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 311

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
ِ وَّ رَّوَّ ى سَّ عْ ذُّ ن ْن ُّ إ ِسْ مَّاعِ ي لَّ عَّن ْ إ َّن ِي هِ عَّن ِ إَّلزِّص َّ ا عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ إ َّن َّهُّ ق َّالَّ: سَّ ا َّلْي ُّهُّ عَّن إَّلز َّج ُّ لِ ي ُّق َّارِف ُّ إَّلذ َّن ْث َّ ي ُّصَّ ل َّى
َّج َّ لْق َّهُّ إ َّمْ لأَّ ق َّالَّ «لأ .
english_text:
Saʿd ibn Ismail narrated from his father, who narrated from al-Ridha {a.s}, that
He said:
"I asked him about a man who commits sins ; should one pray behind him or not?"
Imam {a.s} said: "No."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 380 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 85, p. 40

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
ِ وَّ رُّوِى َّ عَّن ْ إ ِسْ مَّاعِ ي لَّ ن ْن ُّمُّ سْ لِمٍ إ َّن َّهُّ سَّ ا َّلَّ إَّلص َّ اذِق َّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
ِعَّن ِ إَّلص َّ لاَّة ِ ج َّ لْف َّ رَّج ُّ لٍ ي ُّكَّذ ِّب ُّ ن ِق َّذَّرِ إَّلل َّه
ُّعَّز َّ وَّ ج َّ ل َّ ق َّالَّ «لِي ُّعِذْ كُّل َّ صَّ لاَّة ٍ صَّ لا َّهَّا ج َّ لْق َّه .
english_text:
It was narrated from Isma'il ibn Muslim that he asked Imam Jafar ibn
Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about praying behind a man who denies (or rejects) the
decree (Qadar) of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic.
He (Al-Sadiq) replied: "He should repeat every prayer he performed behind him”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 380 • Monotheism, Part 1, p. 383 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1182 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 311 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 375 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 85, p. 73

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال ُّإ ِسْ مَّاعِ ي لُّ إَّلْح ُّ عْ ق ِى ُّ لِأ َّن ِى ج َّ عْ ق َّزٍ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
ْ رَّج ُّ ل ي ُّحِ ث ُّ إ َّمِي زَّ إَّلْمُّو ْ مِن ِي ن َّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ وَّ لأَّ ي َّي َّن َّز َّإ ُّ مِن
َّعَّذُّوِّ ةِ وَّ ي َّق ُّولُّ هُّوَّ إ َّجَّ ث ُّ إ ِلَّى َّ مِم َّن ْ ج َّ الَّق َّهُّ ق َّالَّ «هَّذ َّإ مِح ْ لَّظ وَّ هُّوَّ عَّذُّو ق َّلاَّ ي ُّصَّ لِّ وَّ رَّإءَّةُّ و ُّلأَّ كَّزَّإمَّ ه َّ إ ِلأ َّ إ َّن ْ ي َّي َّق ِي َّه .

وج س ي ث إ ن ي زكغ ق ق ل ما جذ ق ه إلأمام من إلأ ذ إن وإلأ ق امه وإركغ، وإ ن كن ث ق ى صلاة ن اق له وإ ق ي مث إلصلاة ق اق طعها وصل
إلق زي ص ه ، وإ ن كن ث ق ى إلق زي ص ه ق لا ي ق طعها وإج علها ن اق له وسلم ق ى إل زكعي ي ن ، ي م صل مغ إلأمام إ لأ إ ن ي كون إلأمام ممن

ق ي ام وسلم من ق ي ام.
english_text:
Isma'il al-Ju'fi said to Abu Ja'far:
"A man loves The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} but does not
dissociate from his enemies, and he says,
'He (Ali) is dearer to me than those who opposed him.'"
He (Abu Ja'far) replied: "This person is of mixed (belief) and is an enemy; do not pray
behind him, nor is there any respect (to be shown to him) except if you must do so out
of precaution."
commentary:
My father (may Allah {SWT} be pleased with him) said in his letter to me:
"Do not pray behind anyone except for one of two types of people: either someone
whose religion and piety you trust, or someone you must pray behind out of fear of
their power, sword, or harshness towards the religion. Pray behind them as a form of
precaution and accommodation, and in this case, you may make your own intention
and recite for yourself without following them as an Imam. If you finish reciting a surah
before them, leave one verse and continue praising Allah {SWT} until the Imam bows, at
which point you should finish the verse and bow. If you are performing a
supererogatory (nafl) prayer and the congregational prayer is established, stop and
join the obligatory prayer. If you are in an obligatory prayer, do not stop it; instead,
make it a supererogatory prayer, complete it with two units, and then join the Imam.
However, if the Imam is one you fear, do not interrupt your prayer or make it a
supererogatory prayer; simply continue, move to the row, and pray alongside the
congregation. When the Imam stands for the fourth unit, stand with him, recite the
tashahhud from a standing position, and conclude the prayer."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال ُّإ َّن ُّو ج َّ عْ ق َّزٍ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
َّإ ِن َّ رَّسُّ ولَّ إَّلل َّهِ صَّ ل َّى إَّلل َّهُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ وَّ إ لِهِ صَّ ل َّى ن ِا َّصْ حَّ ان ِهِ ج َّ الِساً ق َّلَّم َّا ق َّزَّع َّ ق َّال
ً«لأَّ ي َّو ُّم َّن َّ إ َّجَّ ذُّكُّمْ ن َّعْ ذِى ج َّ الِسا .
english_text:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"The Messenger of Allah {saws} once led his companions in prayer while seated. When
he finished, He {saws} said: 'None of you should lead others in prayer while seated after
me.'".
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 381 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1263 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 345

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال ُّإَّلص َّ اذِق ُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
«كَّان َّ إَّلن َّن ِى ُّ صَّ ل َّى إَّلل َّهُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ وَّ إ لِهِ وَّ ق َّغَّ عَّن ْ ق َّزَّسٍ ق َّس ُّ ح َّ س ِ ق ُّهُّ إَّلْأ َّي ْمَّن ُّ ق َّصَّ ل َّى
َّن ِهِمْ ج َّ الِساً ق ِى ع ُّزْق َّه ِ إ ُّمِّ إ ِن ْزَّإهِي م .
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"The Prophet {saws} once fell from a horse, injuring the right side of his body, and he led
the people in prayer while seated in the room of Umm Ibrahim”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
ٍوَّ سَّ ا َّلَّ ج َّ مِي لُّ ن ْن ُّ صَّ الِح:
ِإ َّي ُّهُّمَّا إ َّق ْص َّ لُّ ي ُّصَّ لِّى إَّلز َّج ُّ لُّ لِن َّق ْسِ هِ ق ِى إ َّو َّ لِ إَّلْوَّ ق ْث ِ إ َّوْ ي ُّو َّ ج ِّ زُّ ق َّلِي لاً وَّ ي ُّصَّ لِّى ن ِا َّهْل
َّمَّ سْ ح ِ ذِةِ إ ِذ َّإ كَّان َّ إ ِمَّ امَّ هُّمْ ق َّالَّ «ي ُّو َّ ج ِّ زُّ وَّ ي ُّصَّ لِّى ن ِا َّهْلِ مَّ سْ ح ِ ذِةِ إ ِذ َّإ كَّان َّ هُّوَّ إَّلْأ ِمَّ ام.
english_text:
Jamil ibn Salih asked:
"Which is better, for a man to pray by himself at the beginning of the time (for prayer)
or to delay a little and pray with the people of his mosque if he is their Imam?"
He {a.s} replied: "He should delay and pray with the people of his mosque if he is their
Imam."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 381 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 429

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
ُّوَّ سَّ ا َّلَّهُّ رَّج ُّ ل ق َّق َّالَّ لَّهُّ إ ِن َّ لِى مَّ سْ ح ِ ذإً عَّلَّى ن َّاب ِ ذَّإرِى ق َّا َّي ُّهُّمَّا إ َّق ْص َّ لُّ إ ُّصَّ لِّى ق ِى مَّ ن ْز ِلِى ق َّا ُّطِ ي ل
ْإَّلص َّ لاَّة َّ إ َّو
ْإ ُّصَّ لِّى ن ِهِمْ وَّ إ ُّج َّ ق ِّف ُّ ق َّكَّي َّث َّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ «صَّ لِّ ن ِهِمْ وَّ إ َّجْ سِ ن ِ إَّلص َّ لاَّة َّ وَّ لأَّ ي ُّي َّق ِّل .
english_text:
A man asked him:
"I have a mosque at the entrance of my house. Which is better - should I pray at home
where I can make my prayer longer, or should I lead them (in the mosque) and make it
lighter?"
He {a.s} wrote: "Lead them in prayer and perform it well, but do not make it too heavy
(burdensome)”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, V. 1, p. 381 • Al-Wafi, V. 8, p. 1171 • Wasail Al-Shia, V. 8, p. 430

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
َّ وَّ إ ِن َّ عَّلِي اً عَّ ق َّالَّ: ق ِى رَّج ُّ لَّي ْ ن ِ إِج ْ ي َّلَّق َّا ق َّق َّالَّ إ َّجَّ ذُّهُّمَّا كُّن ْث ُّ إ ِمَّ امَّ ك َّوَّ ق َّال إَّلْأ ج َّ زُّ كُّن ْث ُّ إ ِمَّ امَّ ك َّ ق َّالَّ «صَّ لاَّي ُّهُّمَّا
َّ ي َّام َّ ه » ق َّالَّ ق ُّلْث ُّ ق َّا ِن ْ ق َّالَّ إ َّجَّ ذُّهُّمَّا كُّن ْث ُّ إ َّن ْي َّم ُّ ن ِك َّوَّ ق َّال
إَّلْأ ج َّ زُّ كُّن ْث ُّ إ َّن ْي َّم ُّ ن ِك َّ ق َّالَّ «ق َّصَّ لاَّي ُّهُّمَّا ق َّاسِ ذَّة ق َّلْي َّسْ ي َّا ْن ِق َّا .
english_text:
Imam Ali {a.s} said regarding two men who disagreed, with one saying, "I was
your Imam (leader in prayer)," and the other saying, "I was your Imam," that "are their
prayers are valid?."
When asked what if one of them said: "I was following you (as the Imam)," and the
other also said: "I was following you,"
Imam {a.s} said: "Then their prayers are invalid, and they must repeat the prayer”.
references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 375 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 382 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 54 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1277 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 352 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Vol. 6, p. 477

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
english_text:
Jamil ibn Darraj asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about an Imam
who becomes ritually impure (junub) and does not have enough water to perform the
full ritual bath (ghusl), while the rest of the congregation has water to perform ablution
(wudu). He asked whether some of them should perform wudu and then allow the
Imam to lead.
Abu Abdullah {a.s} replied: "No, but the Imam should perform tayammum (dry ablution)
and lead them, for Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, has made the earth a purifier
just as He has made water a purifier”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
ِّوَّ رَّوَّ ى عَّن ْهُّ عُّمَّزُّ ن ْن ُّ ي َّز ِي ذَّ إ َّن َّهُّ ق َّالَّ: «مَّ ا مِن ْكُّمْ إ َّجَّ ذ ي ُّصَّ لِّى صَّ لاَّة ً ق َّزِي ص َّ ه ً ق ِى وَّ ق ْي ِهَّا ي ُّم َّ ي ُّصَّ ل ً ى مَّ عَّهُّمْ صَّ لاَّة
َّ ي َّق ِي َّه ً وَّ هُّوَّ مُّي َّوَّ ص ِّ ى إ ِلأ َّ كَّي َّث َّ إَّلل َّهُّ لَّهُّ ن ِهَّا ج َّ مْ ساً وَّ عِ س ْ زِي ن َّ ذَّرَّج َّ ه ً ق َّارْع َّن ُّوإ ق ِى ذ َّلِك .
english_text:
It is narrated from him by Umar ibn Yazid that Imam {a.s} said:
"None of you prays an obligatory prayer at its prescribed time and then prays with them
(in congregation) as an act of precaution (taqiyya) while in a state of wudu, except that
Allah {SWT} will record for him twenty-five degrees (of reward). So strive for this."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 382 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1218 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 302

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
َّ وَّ رَّوَّ ى عَّن ْهُّ جَّ م َّاذُّ ن ْن ُّ عُّي ْ مَّان َّ إ َّن َّهُّ ق َّالَّ: «مَّ ن ْ صَّ ل َّى مَّ عَّهُّمْ ق ِى إَّلص َّ ف ِّ إَّلْأ َّو َّلِ كَّان َّ كَّمَّن ْ صَّ ل َّى ج ِلْف َّ رَّسُّ ولِ إَّلل َّه
ِصَّ ل َّى إَّلل َّهُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ وَّ إ لِهِ ق ِى إَّلص َّ ف ِّ إَّلْأ َّو َّ ل .
english_text:
It is narrated from him by Hammad ibn Uthman that Imam {a.s} said:
"Whoever prays with them in the first row, it is as if he prayed behind the Messenger of
Allah {saws} in the first row”.
references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 380 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 382 • Al-Arba‘ūn Ḥadīthan (Al-Shahīd al-Awwal) Vol. 1, p. 77 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1218 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1218 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 299 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 300 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 85, p. 98

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
english_text:
It is narrated from him by Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari that Imam {a.s} said:
"It will be counted for you when you join them (in prayer), even if you do not follow them
(in intention); it will be counted for you just as it would if you were with someone you
follow”.
references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 373 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 383 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 265 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1217 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 299

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
َّ وَّ رَّوَّ ى مَّ سْ عَّذَّة ُّ ن ْن ُّ صَّ ذَّق َّه:
ٍ إ َّن َّ ق َّان ِلاً ق َّالَّ لِح َّ عْ ق َّزِ ن ْن ِ مُّ حَّ م َّذٍ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ ج ُّ عِلْث ُّ ق ِذَّإك َّ إ ِن ِّى إ َّمُّ ز ُّ ن ِق َّوْ مٍ ن َّاصِ ن ِي َّه
وَّ ق َّذْ إ ُّق ِي مَّث ْ لَّهُّمُّ إَّلص َّ لاَّة ُّ وَّ إ َّن َّا عَّلَّى ع َّي ْ زِ وُّص ُّ وءٍ ق َّا ِن ْ لَّمْ إ َّذْ ج ُّ لْ مَّ عَّهُّمْ ق ِى إَّلص َّ لاَّة ِ ق َّالُّوإ مَّ ا س َّ اءُّوإ إ َّن ْ ي َّق ُّولُّوإ إ َّ ق َّا ُّصَّ لِّى
َّ مَّ عَّهُّمْ ي ُّم َّ إ َّي َّوَّ ص َّ ا ُّ إ ِذ َّإ إِن ْصَّ زَّق ْث ُّ وَّ إ ُّصَّ لِّى ق َّالَّ ج َّ عْ ق َّزُّ ن ْن ُّ مُّ حَّ م َّذٍ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ «سُّ ن ْحَّ ان َّ إَّلل هِ إ َّ ق َّمَّا ي َّح َّ اف ُّ مَّ ن ْ ي ُّصَّ لِّى
ًعَّلَّى ع َّي ْ زِ وُّ ص ُّ وءٍ إ َّن ْ ي َّا ْج ُّ ذ َّةُّ إَّلْأ َّرْض ُّ ج َّ سْ ق ا .
english_text:
Mas’adah ibn Sadaqah narrates that someone said to Jafar ibn Muhammad
{a.s}:
"May I be your ransom! I pass by a group of Nasibis (those hostile to the AhlulBayt {a.s}),
and their prayer has been established while I am not in a state of wudu (ritual purity).
If I do not join them in prayer, they will say whatever they wish about me. Should I then
pray with them and perform wudu afterward and pray again?"
Jafar ibn Muhammad {a.s} responded: "Glory be to Allah {SWT}! Does he not fear that if he
prays without wudu, the earth would swallow him up?"
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 383 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 43 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 1, p.

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
وَّ رَّوَّ ى عَّن ْهُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ ر َّي ْ ذ إَّلس َّ ح َّ امُّ إ َّن َّهُّ ق َّالَّ: «ي َّا َّر َّي ْذُّ ج َّ الِق ُّوإ إَّلن َّاسَّ ن ِا َّج ْ لاَّق ِهِمْ صَّ ل ُّوإ ق ِى مَّ سَّ اج ِ ذِهِمْ و
ْ عُّوذُّوإ مَّ زْص َّ اهُّمْ وَّ إِس ْ هَّذُّوإ ج َّ ن َّان ِز َّهُّمْ وَّ إ ِن ِ إِسْ ي َّطَّ عْ ي ُّمْ إ َّن ْ ي َّكُّون ُّوإ إَّلْأ َّن ِم َّه َّ وَّ إَّلْمُّو َّ ذ ِّن ِي ن َّ ق َّاق َّ عَّلُّوإ ق َّا ِن َّكُّمْ إ ِذ َّإ ق َّعَّلْي ُّمْ ذ َّلِك
ِق َّالُّوإ هَّو ُّلأَّء
إَّلْح َّ عْ ق َّزِي َّه ُّ رَّجِ مَّ إَّلل َّهُّ ج َّ عْ ق َّزإً مَّ ا كَّان َّ إ َّجْ سَّ ن َّ مَّ ا ي ُّو َّ ذِّب ُّ إ َّصْ حَّ ان َّهُّ وَّ إ ِذ َّإ ي َّزَّكْي ُّمْ ذ َّلِك َّ ق َّالُّوإ
ُّ هَّو ُّلأَّءِ إَّلْح َّ عْ ق َّزِي َّه
ُّق َّعَّلَّ إَّلل َّهُّ ن ِح َّ عْ ق َّزٍ مَّ ا كَّان َّ إ َّسْ وَّ إ َّ مَّ ا ي ُّو َّ ذِّب ُّ إ َّصْ حَّ ان َّه.
english_text:
It is narrated from Zayd al-Shahham that He said: Imam Ja'far Al-Sadiq {a.s}
said:
"O’ Zayd, interact with the people through good character. Pray in their mosques, visit
their sick, and attend their funerals. If you can, be the Imams and callers to prayer
(mu'adhdhins), then do so. For if you do this, they will say,
'These are the Ja'fariyyah; may Allah {SWT} have mercy on Ja'far, how well he trained his
companions!'
But if you do otherwise, they will say,
'These are the Ja'fariyyah; may Allah {SWT} do with Ja'far as he deserves for how badly he
trained his companions!'"
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 383 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1220 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 430

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
"Give the call to prayer (adhan) behind the one you recited the prayer behind”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 383 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 56 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1209 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 443 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 365

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال لَّهُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ رَّج ُّ ل إ ُّصَّ لِّى ق ِى إ َّهْلِى َّي ُّم َّ إ َّج ْ زُّح ُّ إ ِلَّى إَّلْمَّسْ ح ِ ذِ ق َّي ُّق َّذِّمُّون ِى ق َّق َّالَّ «ي َّق َّذ َّمْ لأَّ عَّلَّي ْك َّ و
ْصَّ لِّ ن ِهِم .
english_text:
A man said to him {a.s}:
"I pray with my family, then I go to the mosque and they ask me to lead them in prayer."
Imam {a.s} said: "Go ahead and lead them; there is no harm in it. Pray with them."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 383 • Al-Wafi, V. 8, p. 1218 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p.

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
َّ وَّ رَّوَّ ى هِس َّ امُّ ن ْن ُّ سَّ الِمٍ عَّن ْهُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ إ َّن َّهُّ ق َّالَّ: ق ِى إَّلز َّج ُّ لِ ي ُّصَّ لِّى إَّلص َّ لاَّة َّ وَّ جْ ذَّةُّ ي ُّم َّ ي َّح ِ ذُّ ج َّ مَّاعَّه ً ق َّال
َّ«ي ُّصَّ لِّى مَّ عَّهُّمْ وَّ ي َّح ْ عَّلُّهَّا إَّلْق َّزِي ص َّ ه َّ إ ِن ْ س َّ اء .
english_text:
Hisham ibn Salim narrated from him {a.s} that He said regarding a man who
prays alone and then finds a congregation:
"He may pray with them and count it as his obligatory (fardh) prayer if he wishes”.
references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 379 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 383 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 50 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1247 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 401 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 403

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
english_text:
It has been narrated: "He will be credited with the better and more complete
of the two”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
ٍوَّ سَّ ا َّلَّ عَّلِى ُّ ن ْن ُّ ج َّ عْ ق َّز ُّإ َّج َّ اةُّ مُّ وسَّ ى ن ْن َّ ج َّ عْ ق َّزٍ عَّلَّي ْهِمَّا إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
ُّعَّن ِ إَّلز َّج ُّ لِ هَّلْ ي ُّصَّ لِّى ن ِالْق َّوْ مِ وَّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ سَّ زَّإوِي ل
ِوَّ رِذَّإء ق َّالَّ «لأَّ ن َّا ْسَّ ن ِه .
english_text:
Ali ibn Ja'far asked his brother Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} about a
man leading a group in prayer while wearing trousers (sarawil) and a cloak (rida).
He {a.s} replied: "There is no harm in it”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
ُّوَّ رَّوَّ ى ر ُّرَّإرَّة ُّ عَّن ْ إ َّن ِى ج َّ عْ ق َّزٍ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ إ َّن َّه َّق َّالَّ: «إ ِن َّ إ ج ِ زَّ صَّ لاَّة ٍ صَّ لا َّهَّا رَّسُّ ولُّ إَّلل َّهِ صَّ ل َّى إَّلل َّهُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ و
ِإ لِهِ ن ِالن َّاسِ ق ِى ي َّوْ ب ٍ وَّ إجِ ذٍ ق َّذْ ج َّ الَّف َّ ن َّي ْن َّ طَّ زَّق َّي ْ هِ إ َّ لأَّ إ ُّرِي ك َّ إَّلي َّوْ ب َّ » ق ُّلْث ُّ ن َّلَّى ق َّالَّ ق َّا َّج ْ زَّح َّ م ْ لْحَّ ق َّه ً ق َّذ َّرَّعْ ي ُّهَّا وَّ كَّان َّث
ْ سَّ ن ْعَّه َّ إ َّذ ٍرُّعٍ ق ِى ي َّمَّان ِي َّه ِ إ َّس ْ ن َّار .
english_text:
Zurarah narrated from Imam Al-Baqir {a.s} that He said: "The last prayer that
the Messenger of Allah {saws} led the people in was while wearing a single garment, with
its ends crossed over one another. Shall I show you the garment?" I said: "Yes."
He then brought out a cloak, and I measured it - it was seven cubits by eight hand
spans.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 384 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 4, p. 391

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
ُّوَّ سَّ ا َّلَّ عُّمَّزُّ ن ْن ُّ ي َّز ِي ذَّ ، إ َّن َّا عَّن ْذِ إَّلل َّهِ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
عَّن ِ إَّلزِّوَّ إي َّه ِ إَّل َّي ِى ي َّزْوُّون َّ إ َّن َّهُّ لأَّ ي َّن ْن َّع ِى إ َّن ْ ي ُّي َّطَّ و َّ عَّ ق ِى
وَّ ق ْث ِ كُّلِّ ق َّزِي ص َّ ه ٍ مَّ ا جَّ ذ ُّ هَّذ َّإ إَّلْوَّ ق ْث ِ ق َّق َّالَّ «إ ِذ َّإ إ َّج َّ ذ َّ إَّلْمُّق ِي مُّ ق ِى إَّلْأ ِق َّامَّ ه ِ » ق َّق َّالَّ لَّهُّ إ ِن َّ إَّل ِ ن َّاسَّ ي َّح ْ ي َّلِق ُّون َّ ق ِى إَّلْأ ِق َّامَّ ه
ْق َّالَّ «إَّل ُّمُّق ِي مُّ إَّل َّذ ِى ي ُّصَّ ل َّى مَّ عَّه .
english_text:
Umar ibn Yazid asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about the
narration that states it is not appropriate to perform supererogatory (nafl) prayers at
the time of every obligatory (fardh) prayer.
He asked: "What is the limit for this time?"
He {a.s} replied: "When the person giving the iqamah (call immediately preceding the
prayer) begins the iqamah."
Umar said: "People differ in the timing of the iqamah."
He {a.s} responded: "The one giving the iqamah is the one with whom the prayer is being
established”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 384 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 283

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
ٍوَّ سَّ ا َّلَّهُّ جَّ ق ْ ضُّ ن ْن ُّ سَّ الِم:
إ ِذ َّإ ق َّالَّ إَّلْمُّو َّ ذ ِّن ُّ ق َّذْ ق َّامَّ ث ِ إَّلص َّ لاَّة ُّ إ َّ ي َّق ُّومُّ إَّلن َّاسُّ عَّلَّى إ َّرْج ُّ لِهِمْ إ َّوْ ي َّح ْ لِسُّ ون َّ جَّ ي َّى
ُّ ي َّح ِ ى ءَّ إ ِمَّ امُّهُّمْ ق َّالَّ «لأَّ ن َّلْ ي َّق ُّومُّون َّ عَّلَّى إ َّرْج ُّ لِهِمْ ق َّا ِن ْ ج َّ اءَّ إ ِمَّ امُّهُّمْ وَّ إ ِلأ َّ ق َّلْي ُّو ْ ج َّ ذ ْ ن ِي َّذِ رَّج ْلٍ مِن َّ إَّلْق َّو َّمِ ق َّي ُّق َّذ َّم .
english_text:
Hafs ibn Salim asked: "When the muezzin (caller to prayer) says 'The prayer
has been established' (during the iqamah), should the people stand up or remain
seated until their Imam arrives?"
He {a.s} replied: "No, they should stand up. If their Imam arrives, they proceed with him;
otherwise, a man from among the congregation should be taken by the hand and
brought forward to lead."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
وروى ر رإرة عن إ ن ى ج عق ز علي ه إلسلام إ ن ه ق ال: " إ ذ إ إ ق ي مث إلصلاة جزم إلكلام على إلأمام وإ هل
إلمسح ذ إ لأ ق ى ي ق ذي م إ مام .
english_text:
Zurarah narrated from Imam Al-Baqir {a.s} that He said: "When the prayer has
been established (by the iqamah), speaking becomes forbidden for the Imam and the
people of the mosque, except in the matter of appointing an Imam”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
english_text:
It was narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim that he was asked about a man
leading two others in prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should stand in front of them and not between them."
And regarding two men praying together in congregation, Imam {a.s} said:
"Yes, he (the one leading) should have the other stand on his right”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 385 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 342

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
َّق َّال َّوَّ ق َّال ِرَّسُّ ولُّ إَّلل َّهِ صَّ ل َّى إَّلل َّهُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ وَّ إ لِه:
ْ «إ َّق ِي مُّوإ صُّ ق ُّوق َّكُّمْ ق َّا ِن ِّى إ َّرَّإكُّمْ مِن ْ ج َّ لْق ِى كَّمَّا إ َّرَّإكُّمْ مِن
ْق ُّذ َّإمِى وَّ مِن ْ ن َّي ْن ِ ي َّذَّى َّ وَّ لأَّ ي ُّح َّ الِق ُّوإ ق َّي ُّح َّ الِف َّ إَّلل َّهُّ ن َّي ْن َّ ق ُّلُّون ِكُّم .
english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said:
"Straighten your rows, for I see you from behind me just as I see you from in front of me
and from before me. Do not differ, lest Allah {SWT} cause discord among your hearts."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 385 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 423 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 85, p. 74 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Vol. 6, p. 505

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال َّإ َّن ُّو إَّلْحَّ سَّ ن ِ مُّوسَّ ى ن ْن ُّ ج َّ عْ ق َّزٍ ع :
َّ «إ ِن َّ إَّلص َّ لاَّة َّ ق ِى إَّلص َّ ف ِّ إَّلْأ َّو َّلِ كَّالْح ِ هَّاذِ ق ِى سَّ ن ِي لِ إَّلل َّهِ عَّز َّ وَّ ج َّ ل .
english_text:
Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} said:
"Praying in the first row is like striving (jihad) in the way of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and
Majestic."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 385 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1188 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 307

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text: وَّ رَّوَّ ى إَّلْحَّ لَّن ِى ُّ عَّن ْ إ َّن ِى عَّن ْذِ إَّلل َّهِ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ إ َّن َّهُّ ق َّالَّ: «لأَّ إ َّرَّى ًن ِالص ُّ ق ُّوف ِ ن َّي ْن َّ إَّلْأ َّسَّ اطِ ي ن ِ ن َّا ْسا .
english_text:
Al-Halabi narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} that He said:
"I see no harm in rows (of prayer) being between the columns (pillars)."
references: Fiqh al-Reza {a.s}, vol. 1, p. 125 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 386 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 386 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 408 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Vol. 6, p. 499

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ: «إ َّي ِم ُّوإ صُّ ق ُّوق َّكُّمْ إ ِذ َّإ رَّإ َّي ْي ُّمْ ج َّ لَّلاً وَّ لأَّ ي َّص ُّ ز ُّك َّ إ َّن ْ ي َّي َّا َّج َّ زَّ وَّ رَّإءَّك َّ إ ِذ َّإ وَّ ج َّ ذْ ب َّ ص ِ ي ق اً ق ِى
ًإَّلص َّ ف ِّ إَّلْأ َّو َّلِ إ ِلَّى إَّلص َّ ف ِّ إَّل َّذ ِى ج َّ لْق َّك َّ وَّ ي َّمْ س ِ ى َّ مُّ ن ْحَّ زِق ا .
english_text:
Imam {a.s} said:
"Complete your rows when you see a gap, and it does not harm you to move back if
you find tightness in the first row to the row behind you, walking at an angle."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
وَّ رَّوَّ ى ً ر ُّرَّإرَّة ُّ عَّن ْ إ َّن ِى ج َّ عْ ق َّزٍ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ إ َّن َّهُّ ق َّالَّ: «ي َّن ْن َّع ِى لِلص ُّ ق ُّوف ِ إ َّن ْ ي َّكُّون َّ ي َّام َّ ه ً مُّي َّوَّ إصِ لَّه ن َّعْ ص ُّ هَّا إ ِلَّى
ن َّعْ ض ٍ وَّ لأَّ ي َّكُّون َّ ن َّي ْن َّ إَّلص َّ ق َّي ْن ِ مَّ ا لأَّ ي ُّي َّح َّ ط َّ ى ي َّكُّون ُّ ق َّذْ رُّ ذ َّلِك َّ مَّ سْ ق َّظَّ ج َّ سَّ ذِ إ ِن ْسَّ ان ٍ إ ِذ َّإ
َّسَّ ح َّ ذ .
english_text:
Zurarah narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} that He said:
"The rows (in prayer) should be complete and continuous, one row connected to
another, and there should not be a gap between the rows that cannot be crossed, such
that it should only be the space of a human body when in prostration”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 386 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 410

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال ُّإ َّن ُّو ج َّ عْ ق َّزٍ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
ْ«إ ِن ْ صَّ ل َّى ق َّوْ م ن َّي ْ ن َّهُّمْ وَّ ن َّي ْن َّ إَّلْأ ِمَّ امِ مَّ ا لأَّ ي ُّي َّح َّ ط َّ ى ق َّلَّي ْ سَّ ذ َّلِك َّ إَّلْأ ِمَّ امُّ لَّهُّم
ُّن ِا ِمَّ امٍ وَّ إ َّى ُّ صَّ ف ٍّ كَّان َّ إ َّهْلُّهُّ ي ُّصَّ ل ُّون َّ ن ِصَّ لاَّة ِ إ ِمَّ امٍ وَّ ن َّي ْن َّهُّمْ وَّ ن َّي ْن َّ إَّلص َّ ف ِّ إَّل َّذ ِى ي َّي َّق َّذ َّمُّه َّ مْ مَّ ا لأَّ ي ُّي َّح َّ ط َّ ى ق ْلَّي ْ سَّ ي ِلْك َّ لَّهُّم
َّن ِصَّ لاَّة ٍ وَّ إ ِن ْ كَّان َّ سِ ي ْزإً إ َّوْ ج ِ ذَّإرإً ق َّلَّي ْ سَّ ي ِلْك َّ لَّهُّمْ ن ِصَّ لاَّة ٍ إ ِلأ َّ مَّ ن ْ كَّان َّ جِ ي َّالَّ إَّلْن َّاب ِ » ق َّال َّوَّ ق َّال «هَّذ ِةِ إَّلْمَّق َّاصِ ي زُّ إ ِن َّمَّا
ًإ َّجْ ذَّي َّهَّا إَّلْح َّ ن َّارُّون َّ وَّ لَّي ْ سَّ لِمَّن ْ صَّ ل َّى ج َّ لْق َّهَّا مُّق ْي َّذِي ا َّ ن ِصَّ لاَّة ِ مَّ ن ْ ق ِي هَّا صَّ لاَّة » ق َّال َّوَّ ق َّال ٍ«إ َّي ُّمَّا إِمْ زَّإ َّة ٍ صَّ ل َّث ْ ج َّ لْف َّ إ ِمَّ ام
ْ وَّ ن َّي ْن َّهَّا وَّ ن َّي ْن َّهُّ مَّ ا لأَّ ي ُّي َّح َّ ط َّ ى ق َّلَّي ْسَّ لَّهَّا ي ِلْك َّ ن ِصَّ لاَّة ٍ» ق َّالَّ ق ُّلْث ُّ ق َّا ِن ْ ج َّ اءَّ إ ِن ْسَّ ان ي ُّزِي ذُّ إ َّن
َّ ي ُّصَّ لِّى َّ كَّي ْف َّ ي َّصْ ن َّغُّ وَّ هِى
َّإ ِلَّى ج َّ ان ِث ِ إَّلز َّج ُّ لِ ق َّالَّ «ي َّذْ ج ُّ لُّ ن َّي ْن َّهَّا و ً ن َّي ْن َّ إَّلز َّج ُّ لِ وَّ ي َّن ْحَّ ذِرُّ هِى َّ س َّ ي ْن ا .
english_text:
Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} said:
"If a group prays with a gap between themselves and the Imam that cannot be crossed,
then that Imam is not considered an Imam for them. Any row whose members are
praying following the prayer of an Imam but are separated from the row before them
by a gap that cannot be crossed, that is not a valid prayer for them. If there is a barrier
or a wall, their prayer is also invalid unless one is directly aligned with the door."
Imam {a.s} also said: "These enclosures (maqasir) were introduced by tyrants, and there
is no valid prayer for anyone who prays behind them, following the prayer of those
within."
Furthermore, Imam {a.s} said: "Any woman who prays behind an Imam but with a gap
between her and him that cannot be crossed, her prayer is invalid."
I (the narrator) asked: "If a person comes and wishes to pray, what should they do if
She is beside the man?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "He should enter between her and the man, and She should move
slightly."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
ْ وَّ ق ِى رِوَّ إي َّه ِ عَّن ْذِ إَّلل َّهِ ن ْن ِ سِ ن َّان ٍ عَّن ْ إ َّن ِى عَّن ْذِ إَّلل َّهِ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ ق َّالَّ: «إ َّق َّل ُّ مَّ ا ي َّكُّون ُّ ن َّي ِ ن َّك َّ وَّ ن َّي ْن َّ إَّلْق ِن ْلَّه
ٍمَّ زْن ِض ُّ عَّن ْز ٍ وَّ إ َّكْي َّزُّ مَّ ا ي َّكُّون ُّ مَّ زْن ِظُّ ق َّزَّس .
english_text:
In the narration of Abdullah ibn Sinan from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-
Sadiq {a.s} said:
"The minimum distance that should be between you and the Qibla is the space of a
goat's resting place, and the maximum distance is the tethering place of a horse."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 387 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 4, p. 15 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1191 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 137 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 410 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 80, p. 302

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE

عَّم َّارُّ ن ْن ُّ مُّوسَّ ى :

» ِق َّلاَّ ن َّا ْسَّ ن ِهِ » وَّ سُّ ن ِلَّ ق َّا ِن ْ ق َّامَّ إَّلْأ ِمَّ امُّ إ َّسْ ق َّلَّ مِن ْ مَّ وْ ص ِ غِ مَّ ن ْ ي ُّصَّ لِّى ج َّ لْق َّهُّ ق َّالَّ «لأَّ ن َّا ْسَّ ن ِه َّوَّ ق َّال ْ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ «إ ِن
ِ كَّان َّ إَّلز َّج ُّ لُّ ق َّوْ ق َّ ن َّي ْث ٍ إ َّوْ ع َّي ْ زِ ذ َّلِك َّ ذُّك َّان اً كَّان َّ إ َّوْ ع َّي ْ زَّةُّ وَّ كَّان َّ إَّلْأ ِمَّ امُّ ي ُّصَّ لِّى عَّلَّى إَّلْأ َّرْ ض َّ وَّ إَّلْأ ِمَّ امُّ إ َّسْ ق َّلَّ مِن ْهُّ كَّان
َّلِلز َّج ُّ لِ إ َّن ْ ي ُّصَّ لِّى َّ ج َّ لْق َّهُّ وَّ ي َّق ْي َّذِى َّ ن ِصَّ لاَّي ِهِ و ٍإ ِن ْ كَّان َّ إ َّرْق َّغَّ مِن ْهُّ ن ِس َّ ى ْ ءٍ كَّي ِي ز.
english_text:
Ammar ibn Musa narrated that Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} was
asked about an Imam praying while behind him are people at a lower level than where
he is praying.
Imam {a.s} said: "If the Imam is on something like a platform or at a significantly higher
level than their position, their prayer is invalid. However, if he is elevated by a finger's
width or slightly more or less, due to a natural rise, or if the land is even but has a raised
spot where the Imam stands while those behind him are at a lower level and the land
itself is generally flat but sloped in places, then there is no issue."
He was asked about an Imam standing lower than those behind him
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no issue."
Imam {a.s} further said: "If a person is above, on a roof or a platform or any other elevated
place while the Imam prays on the ground below, it is permissible for the person to
pray behind the Imam and follow his prayer even if the person is significantly higher."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
وَّ سَّ ا َّلَّ مُّوسَّ ى ن ْن ُّ ن َّكْزٍ إ َّن َّا ُّإَّلْحَّ سَّ ن ِ مُّوسَّ ى ن ْن َّ ج َّ عْ ق َّزٍ عَّلَّي ْهِمَّا إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
ُّعَّن ِ إَّلز َّج ُّ لِ ي َّق ُّومُّ ق ِى إَّلص َّ ف ِّ وَّ جْ ذَّة
ٍق َّالَّ «لأَّ ن َّا ْسَّ إ ِن َّمَّا ي َّن ْذُّو إَّلص َّ ف ُّ وَّ إجِ ذإً ن َّعْ ذَّ وَّ إجِ ذ .
english_text:
Musa ibn Bakr asked Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim {a.s} about
a man who stands alone in a row during prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no problem ; indeed, the row is formed one person at a time."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
َّوَّ رُّوِى َّ عَّن ْ عَّن ْذِ إَّلز َّجْ مَّن ِ ن ْن ِ إ َّن ِى عَّن ْذِ إَّلل َّهِ إ َّن َّهُّ ق َّالَّ سَّ مِعْ ث ُّ إ َّن َّا عَّن ْذِ إَّلل َّهِ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لا َّ مُّ ي َّق ُّولُّ: «إ ِذ َّإ ذَّج َّ لْث
ْإَّلْمَّسْ ح ِ ذَّ وَّ إَّلْأ ِمَّ امُّ رَّإكِغ وَّ ط َّ ن َّن ْث َّ إ َّن َّك َّ إ ِن ْ مَّ س َّ ي ْث َّ إ ِلَّي ْ هِ رَّق َّغَّ رَّإ ْسَّ هُّ ق َّكَّن ِّز وَّ إِرْكَّغْ ق َّا ِذ َّإ رَّق َّغَّ رَّإ ْسَّ هُّ ق َّاسْ ح ُّ ذْ مَّ كَّان َّك َّ ق َّا ِذ َّإ
ِّ ق َّامَّ ق َّالْحَّ ق ْ ن ِالص َّ ف ِّ وَّ إ ِن ْ ج َّ لَّسَّ ق َّاج ْ لِسْ مَّ كَّان َّك َّ ق َّا ِذ َّإ ق َّامَّ ق َّالْحَّ ق ْ ن ِالص َّ ف .
english_text:
It was narrated from Abdul Rahman ibn Abi Abdullah that He said:
"I heard Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} say:
"If you enter the mosque and the Imam is in the bowing position (ruku'), and you think
that if you walk towards him, he will raise his head, then pronounce the takbir (opening
supplication) and bow. When the Imam raises his head, prostrate in your place. If the
Imam then stands, join the row. If he sits, remain seated in your place, and when he
stands again, join the row."
references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 385 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 389 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 44 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 436 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1195 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 385

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
وَّ رُّوِى َّ: «إ َّن َّهُّ ي َّمْ س ِ ى ق ِى
إَّلص َّ لاَّة ِ ي َّح ُّ ز ُّ رِج ْ لَّي ْ هِ وَّ لأَّ ي َّي َّح َّ ط َّ ى .
english_text:
It is narrated: "He should walk during the prayer by dragging his feet and not
stepping over (or taking large steps)."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 389 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1195

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
english_text:
Al-Halabi narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} that He said:
"If you reach the Imam while he is in the bowing position (ruku') and you say the takbir
(opening supplication) before the Imam raises his head, then you have caught the
rak'ah (unit of prayer).
However, if he raises his head before you bow, then you have missed that rak'ah."
references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 382 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 389 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 43 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 435 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1227 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 382 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Vol. 6, p. 488

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
english_text:
Abu Usamah narrated that he asked about a man who reaches the Imam
while he is in the bowing position (ruku').
Imam {a.s} said: "If he pronounces the takbir and straightens his back (stands up
properly) and then bows, he has caught the rak'ah."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 389 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1228

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:

ًق َّق َّالَّ «إِصْ ن ِزْ رُّكُّوعَّك َّ وَّ مِي ْلَّ رُّكُّوعِ ك َّ ق َّا ِن ِ إِن ْق َّطَّ عُّوإ وَّ إ ِلأ َّ ق َّان ْي َّصِ ث ْ ق َّان ِما .
english_text:
A man said to Imam Abu Ja'far {a.s},
"I am the Imam of the mosque in our neighborhood, and when I bow (in ruku') with
them, I hear the sound of their footsteps while I am in ruku'."
Imam {a.s} replied: "Remain in your bowing position for as long as your bowing takes,
and if they catch up, (continue); otherwise, stand up straight."
references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 330 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 390 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1263 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 6, p. 334 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 395

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
وَّ رَّوَّ ى َّإ ِسْ حَّ اق ُّ ن ْن ُّ عَّم َّارٍ عَّن ْ إ َّن ِى عَّن ْذِ إَّلل َّهِ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ إ َّن َّهُّ ق َّالَّ: «ي َّن ْن َّع ِى لِلْا ِمَّ امِ إ َّن ْ ي َّكُّون َّ ص لاَّي ُّهُّ عَّلَّى
ُّصَّ لاَّة ِ إ َّص ْ عَّف ِ مَّ ن ْ ج َّ لْق َّه .
english_text:
Ishaq ibn Ammar narrated from Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s}: "It is appropriate for the
Imam's prayer to be suited to the ability of the weakest among those behind him."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 390 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 274 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1262 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 420

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
َّ وَّ كَّان َّ مُّعَّاذ ي َّو ُّم ُّ ق ِى مَّ سْ ح ِ ذٍ عَّلَّى عَّهْ ذِ رَّسُّ ولِ إَّلل َّهِ صَّ ل َّى إَّلل َّهُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ وَّ إ لِهِ وَّ ي ُّطِ ي لُّ إَّلْق ِزَّإءَّة وَّ إ َّن َّهُّ مَّ ز َّ ن ِهِ رَّج ُّ ل
َّ ق َّاق ْي َّي َّحَّ سُّ ورَّة ً طَّ وِي لَّه ً ق َّق َّزَّإ َّ إَّلز َّج ُّ لُّ لِن َّق ْ سِ هِ وَّ صَّ ل َّى ي ُّم َّ رَّكِث َّ رَّإجِ لَّي َّهُّ ق َّن لَّغ َّ ذ َّلِك َّ إَّلن َّن ِى َّ صَّ ل َّى إَّلل َّهُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ وَّ إ لِهِ ق َّن َّعَّث َّ إ ِلَّى
مُّعَّاذ ٍ ق َّق َّالَّ «ي َّا مُّ عَّاذ ُّ إ ِي َّاك َّ إ َّن ْ ي َّكُّون َّ ق َّي َّان اً عَّلَّي ْك َّ ن ِالس َّ مْ سِ وَّ ص ُّ حَّ ي هَّا وَّ ذ َّوَّ إي ِهَّا.
english_text:
Mu'adh used to lead prayer in a mosque during the time of the Messenger of
Allah {saws} and would make the recitation lengthy.
One day, a man passed by while Mu'adh was reciting a long Surah, so the man recited
(the prayer) for himself, completed it, and then rode off on his mount.
When this incident reached The Prophet {saws}, he sent for Mu'adh and said:
"O’ Mu'adh, be careful not to be a source of hardship (fitnah). Recite from the shorter
Surahs like 'By the sun and its brightness' (Ash-Shams) and similar ones."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, V. 1, p. 390 • Al-Wafi, V. 8, p. 1261 • Wasail Al-Shia, V. 8, p. 420

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE

وعلى إلأمام إ ن ي ق زإ ق زإءة وسطا لأن إلله عز وج ل ي ق ول: " ولأ ي ح هز ن صلاي ك ولأ ي ح اق ث ن ها.
وإ ذ إ ق زع إلأمام من ق زإءة
إلق اي حه ق لي ق ل إلذ ى ج لق ه: " إلحمذ لله رب إلعالمي ن.

english_text:
The Prophet {saws} was leading his companions in prayer one day when he
heard the crying of a child, so he shortened the prayer.
commentary:
The Imam should recite in a moderate manner because Allah {SWT}, the Almighty, says:
"Do not be loud in your prayer, nor too quiet in it" (Surah Al-Isra 17:110).
When the Imam finishes reciting Surah Al-Fatiha, those behind him should say: "All
praise is due to Allah {SWT}, the Lord {AZJ} of all worlds."
It is not permissible to say "Ameen" after the recitation of Surah Al-Fatiha because that
was the practice of the Christians.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 390 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1262 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 23, p. 1387 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 420

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
ٍوَّ رَّوَّ ى ر ُّرَّإرَّة ُّ وَّ مُّ حَّ م َّذُّ ن ْن ُّ مُّ سْ لِمٍ عَّن ْ إ َّن ِى ج َّ عْ ق َّز ُّعَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ إ َّن َّهُّ ق َّالَّ كَّان َّ إ َّمِي زُّ إَّلْمُّو ْ مِن ِي ن َّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم
ٍ ي َّق ُّولُّ: «مَّ ن ْ ق َّزَّإ َّ ج َّ لْف َّ إ ِمَّ امٍ ي َّا ْي َّم ُّ ن ِهِ ق َّمَّاب َّ ن ُّعِث َّ عَّلَّى ع َّي ْ زِ ق ِطْ زَّة.
english_text:
Zurarah and Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali
Al-Baqir {a.s} that He said:
Amir al-Mu'minin {a.s} used to say: "Whoever recites (aloud) behind an Imam whom he
follows (in prayer) and then dies will be resurrected on a different (incorrect) natural
disposition (fitra)."
references: Al Mahasin, Part 1, p. 79 • Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 377 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 390 • Thawab al-A’mal wa Iqab al-A’mal, Part 1, p. 230 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 269 • Al-Sarāʾir, Part 3, p. 588 • Aʿlām al-Dīn, Part 1, p. 402 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 3, p. 108 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1201 • Wasail Al- Shia, Vol. 8, p. 356

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
ُّ وَّ رَّوَّ ى إَّلْحَّ لَّن ِى ُّ عَّن ْ إ َّن ِى عَّن ْذِ إَّلل َّهِ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ إ َّن َّهُّ ق َّالَّ: «إ ِذ َّإ صَّ ل َّي ْ ث َّ ج َّ لْف َّ إ ِمَّ امٍ ي َّا ْي َّم ْ ن ِهِ ق َّلاَّ ي َّق ْ زَّإ ُّج َّ لْق َّه
ْ سَّ مِعْ ث َّ ق ِزَّإءَّي َّهُّ إ َّوْ لَّمْ ي َّسْ مَّغْ إ ِلأ َّ إ َّن ْ ي َّكُّون َّ صَّ لاَّة ً ي ُّح ْ هَّزُّ ق ِي هَّا ن ِالْق ِزَّإءَّة ِ ق َّلَّمْ ي َّسْ مَّغْ ق َّاق ْزَّإ.
english_text:
Al-Halabi narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} that He said:
"If you are praying behind an Imam whom you are following, do not recite (the Qur'an)
behind him, whether you hear his recitation or not, except in a prayer where the
recitation is done aloud and you do not hear it - then you may recite."
references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 377 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 391 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 32 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 428 • Awaali al-La’aali, Part 3, p. 108 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1199 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 355

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
english_text:
In a narration from Ubayd ibn Zurarah from Imam {a.s}:
"If he (the follower) hears a murmur (of the Imam's recitation), he should not recite."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
َّ وَّ رَّوَّ ى ر ُّرَّإرَّة ُّ عَّن ْ إ َّن ِى ج َّ عْ ق َّزٍ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ إ َّن َّهُّ ق َّالَّ: «لأَّ ي َّق ْ زَّإ َّن َّ ق ِى إَّلز َّكْعَّي َّي ْن ِ إَّلْأ َّج ِ ي زَّي َّ ي ْن ِ مِن ِ إَّلْأ َّرْن َّغِ إَّلز َّكَّعَّاب
َّ إَّلْمَّق ْ زُّوص َّ اب ِ س َّ ي ْن اً إ ِمَّ اماً كُّن ْث َّ إ َّوْ ع َّي ْ زَّ إ ِمَّ امٍ » ق َّالَّ ق ُّلْث ُّ ق َّمَّا إ َّق ُّولُّ ق ِي هَّا ق َّالَّ «إ ِن ْ كُّن ْث َّ إ ِمَّ اماً إ َّ وْ وَّ جْ ذَّك َّ ق َّق ُّلْ سُّ ن ْحَّ ان
َّ إَّلل َّهِ وَّ إَّلْحَّ مْ ذُّ لِل َّهِ وَّ لأَّ إ ِلَّهَّ إ ِلأ َّ إَّلل َّهُّ ي َّلاَّب َّ مَّ ز ُّإب ٍ ي ُّكَّمِّلُّهُّ ي ِسْ غَّ ي َّسْ ن ِي حَّ اب ٍ ي ُّم َّ ي ُّكَّن ِّزُّ وَّ ي َّزْ كَّغ .
english_text:
Zurarah narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} that He said:
"Do not recite anything (from the Qur'an) in the last two rak'ahs of the four obligatory
rak'ah prayers, whether you are an Imam or not."
I (Zurarah) asked: "So what should I say in them?"
Imam {a.s} said: "If you are an Imam or praying alone, say: 'Subhan Allah {SWT} (Glory be
to Allah {SWT}), Alhamdulillah (Praise be to Allah {SWT}), and La ilaha illAllah {SWT} (There is
no god but Allah {SWT})' three times, making a total of nine glorifications. Then say the
takbir and bow (for ruku')."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 392 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 775 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 6, p.

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:

ق ِى إَّلز َّكْعَّي َّي ْن ِ إَّلْأ َّج ِ ي زَّي َّي ْن ِ ي َّلاَّب ُّ ي َّسْ ن ِي حَّ اب ٍ إ َّن ْ ي َّق ُّولَّ: سُّ ن ْحَّ ان َّ إَّلل َّهِ سُّ ن ْحَّ ان َّ إَّلل َّهِ سُّ ن ْحَّ ان َّ إَّل ِل َّه .
english_text:
Wuhayb ibn Hafs narrated from Abu Basir, from Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s}, who said:
"The minimum that suffices in the last two rak'ahs is to say three tasbihat
(glorifications), by saying: 'Subhan Allah {SWT} (Glory be to Allah {SWT}), Subhan Allah {SWT},
Subhan Allah {SWT}.'"
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 392 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 775 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 6, p. 109 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 82, p. 91

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
َّ وَّ ق ِى رِوَّ إي َّه ِ ر ُّرَّإرَّة َّ عَّن ْ إ َّن ِى ج َّ عْ ق َّزٍ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ ق َّالَّ: «وَّ إ ِن ْ كُّن ْث َّ ج َّ لْف َّ إ ِمَّ امٍ ق َّلاَّ ي َّق ْ زَّإ َّن َّ س ِ ي ْن اً ق ِى إَّلْأ َّو َّلَّي َّي ْ ن
َّ وَّ إ َّن ْصِ ث ْ لِق ِزَّإءَّي ِهِ وَّ لأَّ ي َّق ْ زَّإ َّن َّ س َّ ي ْن اً ق ِى إَّلْأ َّج ِ ي زَّي َّي ْن ِ ق َّا ِن َّ إَّلل َّهَّ عَّز َّ وَّ ج» ُّ ل َّ ي َّق ُّولُّ لِلْمُّو ْ مِن ِي ن َّ ، «وَّ إ ِذ ٰ إ ق ُّزِى َّ إَّلْق ُّزْإ ن
ي َّعْ ن ِى
َّ ق ِى إَّلْق َّزِي ص َّ ه ِ ج َّ لْف » َّ إَّلْأ ِمَّ امِ «ق َّاسْ ي َّمِعُّوإ لَّهُّ وَّ إ َّن ْصِ ي ُّوإ لَّعَّل َّكُّمْ ي ُّزْجَّ مُّون
ِ ق َّالْأ َّج ِ ي زَّي َّان ِ ي َّن َّعاً لِلْا َّو َّلَّي َّي ْن.
english_text:
In a narration from Zurarah about Imam Al-Baqir {a.s}, He said:
"If you are behind an Imam, do not recite anything during the first two rak'ahs; instead,
listen to his recitation and remain silent. Do not recite anything in the last two rak'ahs
either, for Allah {SWT}, the Almighty, says to the believers:
'When the Qur'an is recited, listen to it and be silent that you may receive mercy' (Surah
Al-A'raf 7:204). The last two rak'ahs are a continuation of the first two."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 392 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1200 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 355 • Tafsir Kanz al-Daqa’iq, Part 5, p. 270

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
ُّوَّ رَّوَّ ى ن َّكْزُّ ن ْن ُّ مُّ حَّ م َّذٍ إَّلْأ َّر ْ ذِى ُّ عَّن ْ إ َّن ِى عَّن ْذِ إَّلل َّهِ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ إ َّن َّهُّ ق َّالَّ: «إ ِن ِّى إ َّكْزَّة َّ لِلْمَّزْءِ إ َّن ْ ي ُّصَّ لِّى َّ ج َّ لْف
ُّ إَّلْأ ِمَّ امِ صَّ لاَّة ً لأَّ ي ُّح ْ هَّزُّ ق ِي هَّا ن ِالْق ِزَّإءَّة ِ ق َّي َّق ُّومَّ كَّا َّن َّهُّ جِ مَّار » ق َّالَّ ق ُّلْث ُّ ج ُّعِلْث ُّ ق ِذَّإك َّ ق َّي َّصْ ن َّغُّ مَّ ا ذ َّإ ق َّالَّ «ي ُّسَّ ن ِّح .
english_text:
Bakr ibn Muhammad Al-Azdi narrated by Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq
{a.s} that He said: "I dislike it for a person to pray behind the Imam in a prayer where the
recitation is not audible, and he stands there like a donkey."
I (Bakr) asked: "May I be your ransom, what should he do then?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "He should engage in tasbih (glorification)."
references: Qurb al-Isnād, Part 1, p. 37 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 392 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 276 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1205 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 360 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 85, p. 79

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
ْوَّ رَّوَّ ى عُّمَّزُّ ن ْن ُّ إ ُّذ َّي ْ ن َّه َّ عَّن ْ ر ُّرَّإرَّة َّ عَّن ْ إ َّن ِى ج َّ عْ ق َّزٍ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ ق َّالَّ: «إ ِذ َّإ إ َّذْ رَّك َّ إَّلز َّج ُّ لُّ ن َّع ُّض َّ إَّلص َّ لاَّة ِ وَّ ق َّاي َّه
َّن َّعْ ض ج َّ لْف َّ إ ِمَّ امٍ ي َّحْ ي َّسِ ث ُّ ن ِالص َّ لاَّة ِ ج َّ لْق َّهُّ ج َّ عَّلَّ مَّ ا إ َّذْ رَّك َّ إ َّو َّلَّ صَّ لاَّي ِهِ إ ِن ْ إ َّذْ ر ِ ك َّ مِن َّ إَّلط ُّ هْ زِ إ َّوِ إَّلْعَّصْ زِ إ َّوِ إَّلْعِس َّ اءِ إَّلْأ ج ِ زَّة
ِرَّكْعَّي َّي ْن ِ وَّ ق َّاي َّي ْهُّ رَّكْعَّي َّان ِ ق َّزَّإ َّ ق ِى كُّلِّ رَّكْعَّه ٍ مِم َّا إ َّذْ رَّك َّ ج َّ لْف َّ إَّلْأ ِمَّ امِ ق ِى ن َّق ْ سِ هِ ن ِا ُّمِّ إَّلْك َّي َّاب ِ ، ق َّا ِذ َّإ سَّ ل َّمَّ إَّلْأ ِمَّ امُّ ق َّام
ِ ق َّصَّ ل َّى إَّلْأ َّج َّي زَّي َّي ْن ِ لأَّ ي َّق ْ زَّإ ُّ ق ِي هِمَّا إ ِن َّمَّا هُّوَّ ي َّسْ ن ِي ح وَّ ي َّهْ لِي ل وَّ ذُّعَّاء لَّي ْسَّ ق ِي هِمَّا ق ِزَّإءَّة وَّ إ ِن ْ إ َّذْ رَّك َّ ر َّ كْعَّه ً ق َّزَّإ َّ ق ِي هَّا ج َّ لْف
َّ إَّلْأ ِمَّ امِ ق َّا ِذ َّإ سَّ ل َّمَّ إَّلْأ ِمَّ امُّ ق َّامَّ ق َّق َّزَّإ َّ إ ُّم َّ إَّلْكِي َّاب ِ ، ي ُّم َّ ق َّعَّذَّ ق َّي َّس َّ ه َّذَّ ي ُّم ق َّامَّ ق َّصَّ ل َّى رَّكْعَّي َّي ْن ِ لَّي ْ سَّ ق ِي هِمَّا ق ِزَّإءَّة .
english_text:
Umar ibn Udhayna narrated from Zurarah by Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-
Baqir {a.s} that He said:
"If a person joins a congregational prayer after some of it has passed but counts their
prayer as valid behind the Imam, then what they have caught counts as the beginning
of their prayer.
For example, if they join the Dhuhr, Asr, or Isha prayers and catch two rak'ahs and miss
two, they should recite Surah Al-Fatiha (the Mother of the Book) quietly in each of the
two rak'ahs they perform behind the Imam.
When the Imam completes the prayer (with taslim), the individual should stand and
complete their remaining two rak'ahs, during which they do not recite but engage in
tasbih (glorification), tahleel (saying 'La ilaha illAllah {SWT}'), and supplication without
recitation. If the person joins and catches one rak'ah, they should recite Surah Al-
Fatiha quietly in that rak'ah behind the Imam.
When the Imam finishes with taslim, the individual should stand, recite Surah Al-
Fatiha, sit for tashahhud, then stand and complete two more rak'ahs without
recitation."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
َّوَّ رَّوَّ ى عُّن َّي ْ ذُّ إَّلل َّهِ ن ْن ُّ عَّلِى ٍّ إَّلْحَّ لَّن ِى ُّ عَّن ْ ر ُّرَّإرَّة َّ عَّن ْ إ َّن ِى عَّن ْذِ إَّلل َّهِ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ ق َّالَّ: س ُّ ا َّلْي ُّهُّ عَّن ِ إَّلز َّج ُّ لِ ي َّكُّون
ِ ج َّ لْف َّ إَّلْأ ِمَّ امِ ق َّي ُّطِ ي لُّ إَّلْأ ِمَّ امُّ إَّلي َّس َّ ه ُّذَّ ق َّالَّ «ي ُّسَّ لِّمُّ وَّ ي َّمْ ص ِ ى لِحَّ اج َّ ي ِهِ إ َّ ن ْ إ َّجَّ ث .
english_text:
Ubaydullah ibn Ali Al-Halabi narrated from Zurarah from Imam Al-Sadiq {a.s}
who said: I asked him about a person who is behind the Imam, and the Imam prolongs
the tashahhud (sitting for testimony).
Imam {a.s} said: "He may perform the taslim (salutation of peace) and leave if he
wishes."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 393 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 2, p. 317 • Tahdhib Al- Ahkam, Part 2, p. 349 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1273 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 6, p. 416 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 413

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
َّ وَّ سَّ ا َّلَّهُّ إ ِسْ حَّ اق ُّ ن ْن ُّ عَّم َّارٍ ق َّالَّ لَّهُّ: إ َّذْ ج ُّ لُّ إَّلْمَّسْ ح ِ ذَّ وَّ ق َّذْ رَّكَّغَّ إَّلْأ ِمَّ امُّ ق َّا َّرْكَّغُّ ن ِزُّكُّوعِ هِ وَّ إ ُّن َّا وَّ جْ ذِى وَّ إ َّسْ ح ُّ ذ
َّ ق َّا ِذ َّإ رَّق َّعْ ث ُّ رَّإ ْسِ ى ق َّا َّى َّ س َّ ى ْ ءٍ إ َّصْ ن َّغُّ ق َّالَّ «ق ُّمْ ق َّاذ ْ هَّث ْ إ ِلَّي ْهِمْ ق َّا ِن ْ كَّان ُّوإ ق ِي َّاماً ق ْق ُّمْ مَّ عَّهُّمْ وَّ إ ِن ْ كَّان ُّوإ ج ُّ لُّوساً ق َّاج ْ لِس
ْمَّ عَّهُّم.
english_text:
Ishaq ibn Ammar asked Imam {a.s}: "I enter the mosque, and the Imam is
already in the bowing position (ruku'), so I bow with him while I am alone and then
prostrate. When I lift my head, what should I do next?"
Imam {a.s} replied: "Stand up and go to join them (the congregation). If they are standing,
then stand with them, and if they are sitting, then sit with them."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 394 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 281 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1196 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 386

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
ُّ وَّ سَّ ا َّلَّهُّ سَّ مَّاعَّه:
ِ عَّن ِ إَّلز َّج ُّ لِ ي َّا ْي ِى إَّلْمَّسْ ح ِ ذَّ وَّ ق َّذْ صَّ ل َّى إ َّهْلُّهُّ ي َّن ْذَّإ ُّ ن ِالْمَّكْي ُّون َّه ِ إ َّوْ ي َّي َّطَّ و َّعُّ ق َّق َّالَّ «إ ِن ْ كَّان َّ ق ى
ْ وَّ ق ْث ٍ جَّ سَّ ن ٍ ق َّلاَّ ن َّا ْسَّ ن ِالي َّطَّ و ُّعِ ق َّن ْلَّ إَّلْق َّزِي ص َّ ه ِ وَّ إ ِن ْ كَّان َّ ج َّ اف َّ ج ُّ زُّوح َّ إَّلْوَّ ق ْث ِ إ َّج َّ زَّةُّ وَّ لْي َّن ْذَّإ ِ ن ِالْق َّزِي ص َّ ه ِ وَّ هُّوَّ جَّ ق ُّ إَّلل َّه
َّعَّز َّ وَّ ج َّ ل َّ ي ُّم َّ لْي َّي َّطَّ و َّ عْ مَّ ا س َّ اء .
english_text:
Sama’a asked the Imam {a.s} about a man who enters the mosque and finds
that the congregation has already prayed. Should he begin with the obligatory (fardh)
prayer or offer a voluntary (nafl) prayer?
Imam {a.s} said: "If there is still ample time, there is no harm in offering a voluntary
prayer before the obligatory one. However, if he fears that the time for the obligatory
prayer will end, he should prioritize the obligatory prayer, as it is the right of Allah {SWT},
the Almighty. Afterward, he may offer as many voluntary prayers as he wishes."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
ُّوَّ رَّوَّ ى مُّ حَّ م َّذُّ ن ْن ُّ مُّسْ لِمٍ عَّن ْ إ َّجَّ ذِهِمَّا عَّلَّي ْهِمَّا إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
ُّ ق ِى إَّلز َّج ُّ لِ ي َّذْ ج ُّ لُّ إَّلْمَّسْ ح ِ ذَّ ق َّي َّح َّ اف ُّ إ َّن ْ ي َّق ُّوي َّهُّ إَّلز َّكْعَّه
ْق َّالَّ «ي َّزْكَّغُّ ق َّن ْلَّ إ َّن ْ ي َّن ْلُّغ َّ إ ِلَّى إَّلْق َّوْ مِ وَّ ي َّمْ س ِ ى وَّ هُّوَّ رَّإكِغ جَّ ي َّى ي َّن ْلُّع َّهُّم .
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from one of the Imams {a.s} regarding a man
who enters the mosque and fears that he will miss the rak'ah (unit of prayer).
Imam {a.s} said: "He should bow (in ruku') before reaching the congregation and then
walk while in the bowing position until he joins them."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 394 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 44 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 436 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1196 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 384

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
ُّوَّ رَّوَّ ى إ ِن ْزَّإهِي مُّ ن ْن ُّ مَّ ي ْمُّون ٍ عَّن ِ إَّلص َّ اذِق ِ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
ِ ق ِى إَّلز َّج ُّ لِ ي َّو ُّ م ُّ إَّلن ِّسَّ اءَّ لَّي ْسَّ مَّ عَّهُّن َّ رَّج ُّ ل ق ِى إَّلْق َّزِي ص َّ ه
ِق َّالَّ «ن َّعَّمْ وَّ إ ِن ْ كَّان َّ مَّ عَّهُّ صَّ ن ِى ق َّلْي َّق ُّمْ إ ِلَّى ج َّ ان ِن ِه.
english_text:
Ibrahim ibn Maymun narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}
regarding a man leading women in the obligatory prayer, with no other man present.
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, he may lead them, and if there is a boy present, he should stand
beside him."
references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 377 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 394 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 268 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1221 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 333 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 342

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
english_text:
Ammar Al-Sabati narrated that he asked Imam {a.s} about a man who gives the
adhan (call to prayer) and iqamah (call to commence the prayer) intending to pray
alone. Then another person arrives and asks to pray in congregation. He asked
whether they may use the same adhan and iqamah.
Imam {a.s} replied: "No, rather he should give the adhan and iqamah again."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 394 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 282 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 605 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 432

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
english_text:
The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said:
"There is no problem if a young boy (who has not yet reached puberty) gives the adhan
(call to prayer), but he should not lead the prayer until he has reached puberty. If he
leads, his own prayer is valid, but the prayer of those who follow him is invalid."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 395 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 29 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 423 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1179 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 322

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
ِوَّ سَّ ا َّلَّ عَّم َّار إَّلس َّ ان َّاطِ ى ُّ إ َّن َّا عَّن ْذ ُّإَّلل َّهِ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
َّ عَّن ْ رَّج ُّ لٍ إ َّذْ رَّك َّ إَّلْأ ِمَّ امَّ جِ ي ن َّ ي ُّسَّ لِّمُّ ق َّالَّ «عَّلَّي ْ هِ إ َّن ْ ي ُّو َّ ذ ِّن
َّ وَّ ي ُّق ِي مَّ وَّ ي َّق ْي َّي ِحَّ إَّلص َّ لاَّة.
english_text:
Ammar al-Sabati asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about a man
who arrives at the mosque just as the Imam is concluding the prayer with the taslim
(final salutation).
Imam {a.s} replied: "He should give the adhan (call to prayer), make the iqamah (call to
commence the prayer), and then begin his prayer."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 395 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 609 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1235 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p. 431

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
َّوَّ سُّ ن ِل:
ُّ عَّن ِ إَّلز َّج ُّ لِ ي َّا ْي ِى إَّلْمَّسْ ح ِ ذَّ وَّ هُّمْ ق ِى إَّلص َّ لاَّة ِ وَّ ق َّذْ سَّ ن َّق َّهُّ إَّلْأ ِمَّ امُّ ن ِزَّكْعَّه ٍ ق َّي ُّكَّن ِّزُّ ق َّي َّعْ ي َّل ُّ إَّلْأ ِمَّ امُّ ق َّي َّا ْج ُّ ذ
ُّن ِي َّذِةِ وَّ ي َّكُّون ُّ إ َّذْ ن َّى إَّلْق َّوْ مِ إ ِلَّي ْ هِ ق َّي ُّق َّذِّمُّ هُّ ق َّق َّالَّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّمُّ «ي ُّي ِم ُّ ن ِهِم ِإَّلص َّ لاَّة َّ ي ُّم َّ ي َّح ْ لِسُّ جَّ ي َّى إ ِذ َّإ ق َّزَّع ُّوإ مِن َّ إَّلي َّس َّ ه ُّذ
ُّ إ َّوْ مَّ ا َّ ن ِي َّذِةِ عَّن ِ إَّلْي َّمِي ن ِ وَّ إَّلس ِّ مَّالِ وَّ كَّان َّ ذ َّلِك َّ إَّل َّذ ِى ي ُّومِى ُّ ن ِي َّذِةِ إَّلي َّسْ لِي مَّ إ َّوْ ي ُّق ْص َّ ى صَّ لاَّي ُّهُّمْ وَّ إ َّي َّم َّ هُّوَّ مَّ ا كَّان َّ ق َّاي َّه .
english_text:
A question was asked about a man who enters the mosque while the
congregation is already in prayer, and the Imam is ahead of him by one rak'ah. He
pronounces the takbir, and then the Imam becomes unable to continue (due to illness
or another reason) and takes the man’s hand (indicating him to lead), and he happens
to be the nearest person to the Imam.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should lead them in completing the prayer, then sit until they finish
their tashahhud (final testimony). He should gesture to the right and left with his hand
as a sign of completing the prayer (taslim) or wait until the prayer is completed by the
congregation, after which he can complete what he missed of his own prayer."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Sahl narrated from his father who said:
“I asked Imam Al-Ridha {a.s} about a person who bows (in ruku') with an Imam of a
congregation who is followed, and then raises his head before the Imam.”
Imam {a.s} replied: "He should repeat his bowing (ruku') with him."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
english_text:
Al-Fudayl ibn Yasar asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about a
man who prays behind an Imam whom he is following and raises his head from
prostration (Sujood) before the Imam raises his head.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should prostrate again."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 396 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1255

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
ُّوَّ رَّوَّ ى إَّلْحُّ سَّ ي ْن ُّ ن ْن ُّ ي َّسَّ ارٍ إ َّن َّهُّ سَّ مِغَّ مَّ ن ْ ي َّسْ ا َّلُّ إَّلزِّص َّ ا عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
َّعَّن ْ رَّج ُّ لٍ صَّ ل َّى إ ِلَّى ج َّ ان ِث ِ رَّج ُّ لٍ ق َّق َّام
ِعَّن ْ ي َّسَّ ارِةِ وَّ هُّوَّ لأَّ ي َّعْ لَّمُّ كَّي ْف َّ ي َّصْ ن َّغُّ إ ِذ َّإ عَّلِمَّ وَّ هُّوَّ ق ِى إَّلص َّ لاَّة ِ ق َّالَّ «ي ُّحَّ وِّ لُّهُّ إ ِلَّى ي َّمِي ن ِه .
english_text:
Al-Hussain ibn Yasar narrated that he heard someone asking Imam Al-Ridha
{a.s} about a man who was praying next to another man and stood on his left side without
knowing what to do upon realizing this during the prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should move him to his right side."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال ُّإ َّمِي زُّ إَّلْمُّو ْ مِن ِي ن َّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
َّ«كَّان َّ إَّلن ِّسَّ اءُّ ي ُّصَّ لِّي ن َّ مَّ غَّ إَّلن َّن ِى ِّ صَّ ل َّى إَّلل َّهُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ وَّ إ لِهِ ق َّكُّن َّ ي ُّو ْ مَّ زْن َّ إ َّن ْ لأ
ِي َّزْق َّعْ ن َّ رُّءُّوسَّ هُّن َّ ق َّن ْلَّ إَّلزِّج َّ الِ لِص ِ ي ق ِ إَّلْأ ُّر ُّر .
english_text:
The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s} said:
"The women used to pray with The Prophet {saws}, and they were instructed not to raise
their heads (from prostration) before the men due to the tightness of the garments”.
references: Qurb al-Isnad, Part 1, p. 18 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 396 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1223 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 343 • Wasail Al-Shia, V. 8, p. 343 • Bihar Al Anwar, Vol. 85, p. 42 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Vol. 6, p. 511

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
ُّوَّ سَّ ا َّلَّ هِس َّ امُّ ن ْن ُّ سَّ الِمٍ إ َّن َّا عَّن ْذِ إَّلل َّهِ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم :
عَّن ِ إَّلْمَّزْإ َّة ِ هَّلْ ي َّو ُّ م ُّ إَّلن ِّسَّ اءَّ ق َّالَّ «ي َّو ُّم ُّهُّن َّ ق ِى إَّلن َّاق ِلَّه ِ ق َّا َّم َّ ا
َّ ق ِى إَّلْمَّكْي ُّون َّه ِ ق َّلاَّ وَّ لأَّ ي َّي َّق َّذ َّمُّهُّن َّ وَّ لَّكِن ْ ي َّق ُّومُّ وَّ سَّ طَّ هُّن.
english_text:
Hisham ibn Salim asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} about
whether a woman can lead other women in prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "She may lead them in the nafl (supererogatory) prayers, but not in the
obligatory (fardh) prayers. Moreover, She should not stand in front of them; rather, She
should stand in their midst."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 396 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 205

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
english_text:
Zurarah narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir {a.s} that He said:
“I asked him whether a woman can lead other women in prayer.”
Imam {a.s} said: "No, except for the prayer over the deceased (funeral prayer) if there is
no one more appropriate than her. In that case, She should stand among them in the
row, and She recites the takbir and they follow her."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, V. 1, p. 397 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, P 3, p. 206 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, P 3, p. 268 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 326 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 331 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 427 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1225 • Al-Wafi, V. 24, p. 418 • Wasail Al-Shia, Part 3, p. 117 • Wasail Al-Shia, V. 8, p. 334

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
وَّ رَّوَّ ى هِس َّ امُّ ن ْن ُّ سَّ الِمٍ عَّن ْ إ َّن ِى ُّعَّن ْذِ إَّلل َّهِ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
«صَّ لاَّة ُّ إَّلْمَّزْإ َّة ِ ق ِى مِح ْ ذَّعِ هَّا إ َّق ْص َّ لُّ مِن ْ صَّ لاَّي ِهَّا ق ِى
ِن َّي ْي ِهَّا وَّ صَّ لاَّي ُّهَّا ق ِى ن َّي ْي ِهَّا إ َّق ْص َّ لُّ مِن ْ صَّ لاَّي ِهَّا ق ِى إَّلذ َّإر .
وإلزج ل إ ذ إ إ م إلمزإ ة كان ث ج لق ه عن ي مي ن ه سح وذها مغ ركن ي ي ه.
english_text:
Hisham ibn Salim narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s}:
"A woman's prayer in her private chamber (mikhdah) is better than her prayer in her
house, and her prayer in her house is better than her prayer in the courtyard."
commentary:
Also, when a man leads a woman in prayer, She should stand behind him on his right,
with her prostration aligning with his knees.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 397 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 7, p. 515 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 5, p.

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
ُّ وَّ سَّ ا َّلَّهُّ إَّلْحَّ لَّن ِى:
ْ عَّن ِ إَّلز َّج ُّ لِ ي َّو ُّم ُّ إَّلن ِّسَّ اءَّ ق َّالَّ «ن َّعَّمْ وَّ إ ِن ْ كَّان َّ مَّ عَّهُّن َّ ع ِ لْمَّان ق َّا َّق ِي مُّوهُّمْ ن َّي ْن َّ إ َّي ْذِي هِن َّ وَّ إ ِن
ًكَّان ُّوإ عَّن ِي ذإ .
english_text:
Al-Halabi asked Imam {a.s} about a man leading women in prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, he may lead them, and if there are young boys among them,
position them in front of the women, even if they are servants."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 397 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 343

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
english_text:
Dawud ibn Al-Hussain narrated that the Imam {a.s} said:
"A resident (non-traveler) should not lead a traveler, nor should a traveler lead a
resident. If a man finds himself in a situation where he must lead a congregation of
residents and completes two rak'ahs, he should then offer the taslim (salutation of
peace), take the hand of one of the residents, and place him to lead the rest. When a
traveler prays behind a group of residents, he should complete his prayer with two
rak'ahs and then offer the taslim."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
english_text:
It has been narrated: "If a person fears for himself due to those praying with
him, he should pray the last two rak'ahs and make them voluntary (nafl) prayers”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 398 • Wasail Al-Shia, V8, p. 400 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, V6, p. 467

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
ً وَّ ق َّذْ رُّوِى َّ: «إ َّن َّهُّ إ ِن ْ كَّان َّ ق ِى صَّ لاَّة ِ إَّلط ُّ هْ زِ ج َّ عَّلَّ إَّلْأ َّو َّلَّي َّي ْن ِ ق َّزِي ص َّ ه ً وَّ إَّلْأ َّج ِ ي زَّي َّي ْن ِ ن َّاق ِلَّه ِ وَّ إ ِن ْ كَّان َّ ق ِى صَّ لاَّة
َّإَّلْعَّصْ زِ ج َّ عَّلَّ إَّلْأ َّو َّلَّي َّي ْن ِ ن َّاق ِلَّه ً و ً إَّلْأ َّج ِ ي زَّي َّي ْن ِ ق َّزِي ص َّ ه.
english_text:
It has been narrated: "If it is during the Dhuhr prayer, he should make the first
two rak'ahs obligatory and the last two rak'ahs voluntary.
If it is during the Asr prayer, he should make the first two rak'ahs voluntary and the last
two rak'ahs obligatory."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 398 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1258 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 400 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Vol. 6, p. 467

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
وَّ ق َّذْ رُّوِى َّ: «إ َّن َّهُّ إ ِن ْ كَّان َّ ق ِى َّصَّ لاَّة ِ إَّلط ُّ هْ زِ ج َّ عَّلَّ إَّلْأ َّو َّلَّي َّي ْن ِ إَّلط ُّ هْ زَّ وَّ إَّلْأ َّج ِ ي زَّي َّي ْن ِ إَّلْعَّصْ ز.
وهذ ة إلأ ج ن ار لي سث مح ي لق ه وإلمصلى ن الح ي ار ن ا ي ها إ ج ذ ج ار.
english_text:
It has been narrated: "If it is during the Dhuhr prayer, he should make the first
two rak'ahs for Dhuhr and the last two rak'ahs for Asr."
commentary:
These narrations are not contradictory, and the person praying has the option to follow
any of these practices, and it is permissible.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 398 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1259 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 400 • Mustadrak Al-Wasail, Vol. 6, p. 467

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
ُّ وَّ رَّوَّ ى عَّن ْذُّ إَّلل َّهِ ن ْن إَّلْمُّع ِي زَّة ِ ق َّالَّ كَّان َّ مَّ ن ْصُّ ورُّ ن ْن ُّ جَّ ار ِمٍ ي َّق ُّولُّ: «إ ِذ َّإ إ َّي َّي ْث َّ إَّلْأ ِمَّ امَّ وَّ هُّوَّ ج َّ الِس ق َّذْ صَّ ل َّى
ْرَّكْعَّي َّي ْن ِ ق َّكَّن ِّزْ ي ُّم َّ إِج ْ لِسْ ق َّا ِذ َّإ ق ُّمْ ث َّ ق َّكَّن ِّز.
english_text:
Abdullah ibn al-Mughira narrated that Mansur ibn Hazim used to say:
"If you come to the Imam and he is sitting, having already prayed two rak'ahs, say the
takbir (Allahu Akbar) and then sit. When you stand up, say the takbir again."
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال ُّإَّلص َّ اذِق ُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ إَّلس َّ لاَّم:
ِ«ي ُّح ْ ز ِي ك َّ مِن َّ إَّلْق ِزَّإءَّة ِ إ ِذ َّإ كُّن ْث َّ مَّ عَّهُّمْ مِي ْلُّ جَّ ذِي ث ِ إَّلن َّق ْ س .
ومن صلى مح الف ق ق زإ إلسح ذة ولم ي سح ذ ق لي و م ن زإ سه.
" وإ ذ ق ال إلأم " سمغ إلله لمن جمذة ق ال إلذ ي ن ج لق ه إلحمذ لله
" رب إلعالمي ن وي ح ق ص ون إ صوإي هم، وإ ن كان معهم ق ال: " رن ن ا لك إلحمذ.
english_text:
Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq {a.s} said: "It is sufficient for you to recite
like a whisper to yourself when you are with them (in congregation)."
commentary:
If someone is praying with those who differ in practice and recites a verse of
prostration but does not prostrate, they should bow their head as a gesture.
When the Imam says, "Sami' Allahu liman hamidah (Allah {SWT} hears the one who
praises Him)," those behind him should say, "Alhamdulillahi Rabbil 'Alamin (All praise
is due to Allah {SWT}, the Lord {AZJ} of all worlds)" but in a low voice.
If the person is praying with them, they should say, "Rabbana laka al-hamd (Our Lord
{AZJ}, to You is the praise)."
references: Al-Kafi, Volume 3, p. 315 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 399 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 2, p. 97 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 36 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 321 • Al-Istibsar, Part 1, p. 430 • Al- Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 690 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1207 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 6, p. 128 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 364

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
arabic_text:
َّوَّ ق َّال رَّسُّ ولُّ إَّلل َّهِ صَّ ل َّى ِإَّلل َّهُّ عَّلَّي ْ هِ وَّ إ لِه:
ْ«مَّ ن ْ صَّ ل َّى ن ِق َّوْ مٍ ق َّاج ْ ي َّض َّ ن َّق ْسَّ هُّ ن ِالذ ُّعَّاءِ ذُّون َّهُّمْ ق َّق َّذْ ج َّ ان َّهُّم.
english_text:
The Messenger of Allah {saws} said: "Whoever leads a group in prayer and
reserves the supplication for himself, excluding them, has betrayed them”.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol. 1, p. 400 • Tahdhib Al-Ahkam, Part 3, p. 281 • Al-Wafi, Vol. 8, p. 1264 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 7, p. 106 • Wasail Al-Shia, Vol. 8, p. 425

Chapter Title: CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS VIRTUE
